      </td></tr><tr>
       <td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#unload" id="ref-for-unload"><code>unload</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">Sync
       </td><td style="text-align:center">No
       </td><td style="text-align:center"><a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window⑦">Window</a>, Document, Element
       </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event⑤">Event</a></code>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">No
       </td><td>None
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>For a list of events which are deprecated in this specification, see the
    <a href="#legacy-event-types">Legacy Event Types</a> appendix at the end
    of this document.</p>
    <p class="example" id="example-b517ed94"><a class="self-link" href="#example-b517ed94"></a>
    The following is one way to interpret the above tables: the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#load" id="ref-for-load①"><code>load</code></a>
    event will trigger <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-listener" id="ref-for-concept-event-listener①">event listeners</a> attached on <code>Element</code> nodes
    for that event and on the capture and target phases. This event is not
    cancelable. If an <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-listener" id="ref-for-concept-event-listener②">event listener</a> for the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#load" id="ref-for-load②"><code>load</code></a> event is attached to
    a node other than <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window⑧">Window</a>, <code>Document</code>, or
    <code>Element</code> nodes, or if it is attached to the bubbling phase
    only, this <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-listener" id="ref-for-concept-event-listener③">event listener</a> would not be triggered.
    </p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
    Don’t interpret the above tables as definitive for the listed event types.
    For example, the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#load" id="ref-for-load③"><code>load</code></a> event is used in other specifications, for
    example, in XMLHttpRequest. Similarly, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-eventtarget-dispatchevent" id="ref-for-dom-eventtarget-dispatchevent①">dispatchEvent()</a></code> can
    be used to dispatch untrusted events to listeners on <strong>any</strong>
    object that also implements <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget" id="ref-for-eventtarget②">EventTarget</a></code>.
    </p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
    The event objects associated with the event types described above contain
    additional context information--refer to the description of the DOM
    interfaces for further information.
    </p>
   </section>
   <section>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2" id="events-uievents"><span class="secno">3.2. </span><span class="content">User Interface Events</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-uievents"></a></h3>
    <p>The User Interface event module contains basic event types associated with
	user interfaces and document manipulation.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.1" id="interface-uievent"><span class="secno">3.2.1. </span><span class="content">Interface UIEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#interface-uievent"></a></h4>
    <p class="intro-dom">Introduced in DOM Level 2</p>
    <p>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent">UIEvent</a></code> interface provides specific contextual information
		associated with User Interface events.</p>
    <p>To create an instance of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①">UIEvent</a></code> interface, use the UIEvent
		constructor, passing an optional <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-uieventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-uieventinit">UIEventInit</a></code> dictionary.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		For newly defined events, you don’t have to inherit <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent②">UIEvent</a></code> interface just
		because they are related to user interface.  Inherit only when members of
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-uieventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-uieventinit①">UIEventInit</a></code> make sense to those events.
		</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.1.1" id="idl-uievent"><span class="secno">3.2.1.1. </span><span class="content">UIEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#idl-uievent"></a></h5>
<pre class="def highlight idl">[<a class="idl-code" data-link-type="extended-attribute" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#Exposed" id="ref-for-Exposed"><c- g="">Exposed</c-></a>=<c- n="">Window</c->]
<c- b="">interface</c-> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="interface" data-export="" id="uievent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">UIEvent</c-></code></dfn> : <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event⑥"><c- n="">Event</c-></a> {
  <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent" data-dfn-type="constructor" data-export="" data-lt="UIEvent(type, eventInitDict)|constructor(type, eventInitDict)|UIEvent(type)|constructor(type)" id="dom-uievent-uievent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">constructor</c-></code></dfn>(<a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent/UIEvent(type, eventInitDict), UIEvent/constructor(type, eventInitDict), UIEvent/UIEvent(type), UIEvent/constructor(type)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-uievent-uievent-type-eventinitdict-type" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">type</c-></code></dfn>, <c- b="">optional</c-> <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#dictdef-uieventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-uieventinit②"><c- n="">UIEventInit</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent/UIEvent(type, eventInitDict), UIEvent/constructor(type, eventInitDict), UIEvent/UIEvent(type), UIEvent/constructor(type)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-uievent-uievent-type-eventinitdict-eventinitdict" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">eventInitDict</c-></code></dfn> = {});
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#window" id="ref-for-window⑨"><c- n="">Window</c-></a>? <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" data-readonly="" data-type="Window?" id="dom-uievent-view" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">view</c-></code></dfn>;
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long" id="ref-for-idl-long"><c- b="">long</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" data-readonly="" data-type="long" id="dom-uievent-detail" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">detail</c-></code></dfn>;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><code>UIEvent . view</code>
     </dt><dd>
      
					The <code>view</code> attribute identifies the
					<code>Window</code> from which the event was generated.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>null</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><code>UIEvent . detail</code>
     </dt><dd>
      
					Specifies some detail information about the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event⑦">Event</a></code>, depending
					on the type of event.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value①">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>0</code>.</p>
    </dd></dl>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.1.2" id="idl-uieventinit"><span class="secno">3.2.1.2. </span><span class="content">UIEventInit</span><a class="self-link" href="#idl-uieventinit"></a></h5>
<pre class="def highlight idl"><c- b="">dictionary</c-> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dictionary" data-export="" id="dictdef-uieventinit" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">UIEventInit</c-></code></dfn> : <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dictdef-eventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-eventinit"><c- n="">EventInit</c-></a> {
  <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#window" id="ref-for-window①⓪"><c- n="">Window</c-></a>? <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-default="null" data-dfn-for="UIEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" data-type="Window?" id="dom-uieventinit-view" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">view</c-></code></dfn> = <c- b="">null</c->;
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long" id="ref-for-idl-long①"><c- b="">long</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-default="0" data-dfn-for="UIEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" data-type="long" id="dom-uieventinit-detail" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">detail</c-></code></dfn> = 0;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><code>UIEventInit . view</code>
     </dt><dd>
					Should be initialized to the Window object of the global
					environment in which this event will be dispatched. If this
					event will be dispatched to an element, the view property should
					be set to the Window object containing the element’s
					<code>ownerDocument</code>.
				
     </dd><dt><code>UIEventInit . detail</code>
     </dt><dd>
					This value is initialized to a number that is
					application-specific.
				
    </dd></dl>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.2" id="uievent-algorithms"><span class="secno">3.2.2. </span><span class="content">UIEvent Algorithms</span><a class="self-link" href="#uievent-algorithms"></a></h4>
    <div class="algorithm" data-algorithm="initialize-a-uievent">
     <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.2.1" id="initialize-a-uievent-id"><span class="secno">3.2.2.1. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-export="" id="initialize-a-uievent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">initialize a UIEvent</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#initialize-a-uievent-id"></a></h5>
     <dl>
      <dt data-md="">Input
      </dt><dd data-md="">
       <p><var>event</var>, the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent③">UIEvent</a></code> to initialize</p>
      </dd><dd data-md="">
       <p><var>eventType</var>, a DOMString containing the event type</p>
      </dd><dd data-md="">
       <p><var>eventTarget</var>, the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget" id="ref-for-eventtarget③">EventTarget</a></code> of the event</p>
      </dd><dd data-md="">
       <p><var>bubbles</var>, true if this event bubbles</p>
      </dd><dd data-md="">
       <p><var>cancelable</var>, true if this event is cancelable</p>
      </dd><dt data-md="">Output
      </dt><dd data-md="">
       <p>None</p>
     </dd></dl>
     <ol>
      <li data-md="">
       <p>Initialize the base <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event⑧">Event</a></code> attributes:</p>
       <ol>
        <li data-md="">
         <p><a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-initialize" id="ref-for-concept-event-initialize">Initialize an Event</a> with <var>event</var>, <var>eventType</var>, <var>bubbles</var> and <var>cancelable</var></p>
        </li><li data-md="">
         <p>Set <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target①">target</a></code> = <var>eventTarget</var></p>
       </li></ol>
      </li><li data-md="">
       <p>Initialize the following public attributes:</p>
       <ol>
        <li data-md="">
         <p>Set <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view">view</a></code> = the <var>eventTarget</var>’s <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document" id="ref-for-concept-node-document">node document</a>’s <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#window" id="ref-for-window①①">Window</a></code> object</p>
        </li><li data-md="">
         <p>Set <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail">detail</a></code> = 0</p>
       </li></ol>
      </li><li data-md="">
       <p>Initialize the following historical attributes:</p>
       <ol>
        <li data-md="">
         <p>Set <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which">which</a></code> = 0  (used by both <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent">MouseEvent</a></code> and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑤">KeyboardEvent</a></code>)</p>
       </li></ol>
     </li></ol>
    </div>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.3" id="events-uievent-types"><span class="secno">3.2.3. </span><span class="content">UIEvent Types</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-uievent-types"></a></h4>
    <p>The User Interface event types are listed below.  Some of these events
		use the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④">UIEvent</a></code> interface if generated from a user interface, but
		the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event⑨">Event</a></code> interface otherwise, as detailed in each event.</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.3.1" id="event-type-load"><span class="secno">3.2.3.1. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="load" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">load</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-load"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>load</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface
       </th><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑤">UIEvent</a></code> if generated from a user interface, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event①⓪">Event</a></code> otherwise.
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Sync / Async
       </th><td>Async
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Bubbles
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Trusted Targets
       </th><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window①②"><code>Window</code></a>, <code>Document</code>, <code>Element</code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Cancelable
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Default action
       </th><td>None
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Context<br> (trusted events)
       </th><td>
        <ul>
         <li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event①①">Event</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target②">target</a></code> : common object whose contained resources have loaded
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑥">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view①">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window①③"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑦">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail①">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
        </li></ul>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent⑥">user agent</a> MUST dispatch this event when the DOM
			implementation finishes loading the resource (such as the document)
			and any dependent resources (such as images, style sheets, or
			scripts). Dependent resources that fail to load MUST NOT prevent
			this event from firing if the resource that loaded them is still
			accessible via the DOM. If this event type is dispatched,
			implementations are REQUIRED to dispatch this event at least on the
			<code>Document</code> node.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
			For legacy reasons, <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#load" id="ref-for-load④"><code>load</code></a> events for resources inside the
			document (e.g., images) do not include the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window①④">Window</a> in the
			propagation path in HTML implementations. See <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-html5" title="HTML5">[HTML5]</a> for more
			information.
			</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.3.2" id="event-type-unload"><span class="secno">3.2.3.2. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="unload" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">unload</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-unload"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>unload</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface
       </th><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑧">UIEvent</a></code> if generated from a user interface, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event①②">Event</a></code> otherwise.
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Sync / Async
       </th><td>Sync
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Bubbles
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Trusted Targets
       </th><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window①⑤"><code>Window</code></a>, <code>Document</code>, <code>Element</code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Cancelable
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Default action
       </th><td>None
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Context<br> (trusted events)
       </th><td>
        <ul>
         <li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event①③">Event</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target③">target</a></code> : common object whose contained resources have been removed
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑨">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view②">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window①⑥"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①⓪">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail②">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
        </li></ul>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent⑦">user agent</a> MUST dispatch this event when the DOM
			Implementation removes from the environment the resource (such as
			the document) or any dependent resources (such as images, style
			sheets, scripts). The document MUST be unloaded after the dispatch
			of this event type. If this event type is dispatched,
			implementations are REQUIRED to dispatch this event at least on
			the <code>Document</code> node.</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.3.3" id="event-type-abort"><span class="secno">3.2.3.3. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="abort" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">abort</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-abort"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>abort</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface
       </th><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①①">UIEvent</a></code> if generated from a user interface, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event①④">Event</a></code> otherwise.
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Sync / Async
       </th><td>Sync
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Bubbles
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Trusted Targets
       </th><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window①⑦"><code>Window</code></a>, <code>Element</code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Cancelable
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Default action
       </th><td>None
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Context<br> (trusted events)
       </th><td>
        <ul>
         <li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event①⑤">Event</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target④">target</a></code> : element whose resources have been stopped from loading without error
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①②">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view③">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window①⑧"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①③">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail③">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
        </li></ul>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent⑧">user agent</a> MUST dispatch this event when the loading of a
			resource has been aborted, such as by a user canceling the load
			while it is still in progress.</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.3.4" id="event-type-error"><span class="secno">3.2.3.4. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="error" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">error</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-error"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>error</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface
       </th><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①④">UIEvent</a></code> if generated from a user interface, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event①⑥">Event</a></code> otherwise.
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Sync / Async
       </th><td>Async
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Bubbles
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Trusted Targets
       </th><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window①⑨"><code>Window</code></a>, <code>Element</code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Cancelable
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Default action
       </th><td>None
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Context<br> (trusted events)
       </th><td>
        <ul>
         <li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event①⑦">Event</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target⑤">target</a></code> : element whose resources have been stopped from loading due to error
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①⑤">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view④">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window②⓪"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①⑥">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail④">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
        </li></ul>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent⑨">user agent</a> MUST dispatch this event when a resource failed
			to load, or has been loaded but cannot be interpreted according to
			its semantics, such as an invalid image, a script execution error,
			or non-well-formed XML.</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.2.3.5" id="event-type-select"><span class="secno">3.2.3.5. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="select" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">select</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-select"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>select</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface
       </th><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①⑦">UIEvent</a></code> if generated from a user interface, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event①⑧">Event</a></code> otherwise.
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Sync / Async
       </th><td>Sync
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Bubbles
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Trusted Targets
       </th><td><code>Element</code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Cancelable
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Default action
       </th><td>None
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Context<br> (trusted events)
       </th><td>
        <ul>
         <li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event①⑨">Event</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target⑥">target</a></code> : element whose text content has been selected
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①⑧">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view⑤">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window②①"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent①⑨">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail⑤">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
        </li></ul>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent①⓪">user agent</a> MUST dispatch this event when a user selects
			some text.	This event is dispatched after the selection has occurred.</p>
    <p>This specification does not provide contextual information to access
			the selected text.	Where applicable, a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#host-language" id="ref-for-host-language④">host language</a> SHOULD
			define rules for how a user MAY select content (with consideration
			for international language conventions), at what point the
			<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#select" id="ref-for-select①"><code>select</code></a> event is dispatched, and how a content author MAY
			access the user-selected content.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
			In order to access to user-selected content, content authors will
			use native capabilities of the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#host-language" id="ref-for-host-language⑤">host languages</a>, such as the
			<code>Document.getSelection()</code> method of the HTML Editing APIs
			<a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-editing" title="HTML Editing APIs">[Editing]</a>.
			</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
			The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#select" id="ref-for-select②"><code>select</code></a> event might not be available for all elements in
			all languages.	For example, in <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-html5" title="HTML5">[HTML5]</a>, <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#select" id="ref-for-select③"><code>select</code></a> events can
			be dispatched only on form <code><a data-link-type="element" href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-input-element" id="ref-for-the-input-element">input</a></code> and <code><a data-link-type="element" href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-textarea-element" id="ref-for-the-textarea-element">textarea</a></code> elements.
			Implementations can dispatch <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#select" id="ref-for-select④"><code>select</code></a> events in any context
			deemed appropriate, including text selections outside of form
			controls, or image or markup selections such as in SVG.
			</p>
   </section>
   <section>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="3.3" id="events-focusevent"><span class="secno">3.3. </span><span class="content">Focus Events</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-focusevent"></a></h3>
    <p class="note" role="note">
	This interface and its associated event types and
	<a href="#events-focusevent-event-order">§ 3.3.2 Focus Event Order</a>
	were designed in accordance to the concepts and guidelines defined in
	<a href="http://www.w3.org/WAI/UA/2010/ED-UAAG20-20100308/">User Agent Accessibility Guidelines 2.0</a>
	<a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-uaag20" title="User Agent Accessibility Guidelines (UAAG) 2.0">[UAAG20]</a>,
	with particular attention on the
	<a href="http://www.w3.org/WAI/UA/2010/ED-UAAG20-20100308/#gl-focus-mechanism">focus mechanism</a>
	and the terms defined in the
	<a href="http://www.w3.org/WAI/UA/2010/ED-UAAG20-20100308/#def-focus">glossary entry for focus</a>.
	</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.3.1" id="interface-focusevent"><span class="secno">3.3.1. </span><span class="content">Interface FocusEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#interface-focusevent"></a></h4>
    <p class="intro-dom">Introduced in this specification</p>
    <p>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#focusevent" id="ref-for-focusevent④">FocusEvent</a></code> interface provides specific contextual information
		associated with Focus events.</p>
    <p>To create an instance of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#focusevent" id="ref-for-focusevent⑤">FocusEvent</a></code> interface, use the
		FocusEvent constructor, passing an optional <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-focuseventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-focuseventinit">FocusEventInit</a></code> dictionary.</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.3.1.1" id="idl-focusevent"><span class="secno">3.3.1.1. </span><span class="content">FocusEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#idl-focusevent"></a></h5>
<pre class="def highlight idl">[<a class="idl-code" data-link-type="extended-attribute" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#Exposed" id="ref-for-Exposed①"><c- g="">Exposed</c-></a>=<c- n="">Window</c->]
<c- b="">interface</c-> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="interface" data-export="" id="focusevent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">FocusEvent</c-></code></dfn> : <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent②⓪"><c- n="">UIEvent</c-></a> {
  <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="FocusEvent" data-dfn-type="constructor" data-export="" data-lt="FocusEvent(type, eventInitDict)|constructor(type, eventInitDict)|FocusEvent(type)|constructor(type)" id="dom-focusevent-focusevent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">constructor</c-></code></dfn>(<a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString①"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="FocusEvent/FocusEvent(type, eventInitDict), FocusEvent/constructor(type, eventInitDict), FocusEvent/FocusEvent(type), FocusEvent/constructor(type)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-focusevent-focusevent-type-eventinitdict-type" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">type</c-></code></dfn>, <c- b="">optional</c-> <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#dictdef-focuseventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-focuseventinit①"><c- n="">FocusEventInit</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="FocusEvent/FocusEvent(type, eventInitDict), FocusEvent/constructor(type, eventInitDict), FocusEvent/FocusEvent(type), FocusEvent/constructor(type)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-focusevent-focusevent-type-eventinitdict-eventinitdict" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">eventInitDict</c-></code></dfn> = {});
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget" id="ref-for-eventtarget④"><c- n="">EventTarget</c-></a>? <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="FocusEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" data-readonly="" data-type="EventTarget?" id="dom-focusevent-relatedtarget" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">relatedTarget</c-></code></dfn>;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><code>FocusEvent . relatedTarget</code>
     </dt><dd>
      
					Used to identify a secondary <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget" id="ref-for-eventtarget⑤">EventTarget</a></code>
					related to a Focus event, depending on the type of event.


      <p>For security reasons with nested browsing contexts, when tabbing
					into or out of a nested context, the relevant <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget" id="ref-for-eventtarget⑥">EventTarget</a></code>
					SHOULD be <code>null</code>.</p>
      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value②">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>null</code>.</p>
    </dd></dl>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.3.1.2" id="idl-focuseventinit"><span class="secno">3.3.1.2. </span><span class="content">FocusEventInit</span><a class="self-link" href="#idl-focuseventinit"></a></h5>
<pre class="def highlight idl"><c- b="">dictionary</c-> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dictionary" data-export="" id="dictdef-focuseventinit" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">FocusEventInit</c-></code></dfn> : <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#dictdef-uieventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-uieventinit③"><c- n="">UIEventInit</c-></a> {
  <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget" id="ref-for-eventtarget⑦"><c- n="">EventTarget</c-></a>? <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-default="null" data-dfn-for="FocusEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" data-type="EventTarget?" id="dom-focuseventinit-relatedtarget" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">relatedTarget</c-></code></dfn> = <c- b="">null</c->;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><code>FocusEventInit . relatedTarget</code>
     </dt><dd>
					The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-focuseventinit-relatedtarget" id="ref-for-dom-focuseventinit-relatedtarget">relatedTarget</a></code> should be initialized to the element
					losing focus (in the case of a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focus" id="ref-for-focus②"><code>focus</code></a> or <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focusin" id="ref-for-focusin①"><code>focusin</code></a>
					event) or the element gaining focus (in the case of a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#blur" id="ref-for-blur②"><code>blur</code></a>
					or <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focusout" id="ref-for-focusout①"><code>focusout</code></a> event).
				
    </dd></dl>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.3.2" id="events-focusevent-event-order"><span class="secno">3.3.2. </span><span class="content">Focus Event Order</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-focusevent-event-order"></a></h4>
    <p>The focus events defined in this specification occur in a set order
		relative to one another.  The following is the typical sequence of
		events when a focus is shifted between elements (this order assumes
		that no element is initially focused):</p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><th>Event Type
       </th><th>Notes
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td><em>User shifts focus</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">1
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focus" id="ref-for-focus③"><code>focus</code></a>
       </td><td>Sent after first target element receives focus
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">2
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focusin" id="ref-for-focusin②"><code>focusin</code></a>
       </td><td>Follows the focus event
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td><em>User shifts focus</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">3
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#blur" id="ref-for-blur③"><code>blur</code></a>
       </td><td>Sent after first target element loses focus
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">4
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focusout" id="ref-for-focusout②"><code>focusout</code></a>
       </td><td>Follows the blur event
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">5
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focus" id="ref-for-focus④"><code>focus</code></a>
       </td><td>Sent after second target element receives focus
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">6
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focusin" id="ref-for-focusin③"><code>focusin</code></a>
       </td><td>Follows the focus event
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		This specification does not define the behavior of focus events when
		interacting with methods such as <code>focus()</code> or
		<code>blur()</code>. See the relevant specifications where those methods
		are defined for such behavior.
		</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.3.3" id="events-focusevent-doc-focus"><span class="secno">3.3.3. </span><span class="content">Document Focus and Focus Context</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-focusevent-doc-focus"></a></h4>
    <p>This event module includes event types for notification of changes in
		document <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focus" id="ref-for-focus⑤">focus</a>. There are three distinct focus contexts that are
		relevant to this discussion:</p>
    <ul>
     <li data-md="">
      <p>The <em>operating system focus context</em> which MAY be on one of
many different applications currently running on the computer. One
of these applications with focus can be a browser.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>When the browser has focus, the user can switch (such as with the
tab key) the <em>application focus context</em> among the different
browser user interface fields (e.g., the Web site location bar, a
search field, etc.). One of these user interface fields can be the
document being shown in a tab.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>When the document itself has focus, the <em>document focus
context</em> can be set to any of the focusable elements in the
document.</p>
    </li></ul>
    <p>The event types defined in this specification deal exclusively with
		document focus, and the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#event-target" id="ref-for-event-target①">event target</a> identified in the event
		details MUST only be part of the document or documents in the window,
		never a part of the browser or operating system, even when switching
		from one focus context to another.</p>
    <p>Normally, a document always has a focused element (even if it is the
		document element itself) and a persistent <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focus-ring" id="ref-for-focus-ring">focus ring</a>. When
		switching between focus contexts, the document’s currently focused
		element and focus ring normally remain in their current state. For
		example, if a document has three focusable elements, with the second
		element focused, when a user changes operating system focus to another
		application and then back to the browser, the second element will still
		be focused within the document, and tabbing will change the focus to the
		third element.  A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#host-language" id="ref-for-host-language⑥">host language</a> MAY define specific elements
		which might receive focus, the conditions under which an element MAY
		receive focus, the means by which focus MAY be changed, and the order
		in which the focus changes.  For example, in some cases an element might
		be given focus by moving a pointer over it, while other circumstances
		might require a mouse click. Some elements might not be focusable at
		all, and some might be focusable only by special means (clicking on the
		element), but not by tabbing to it.  Documents MAY contain multiple
		focus rings.  Other specifications MAY define a more complex focus model
		than is described in this specification, including allowing multiple
		elements to have the current focus.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.3.4" id="events-focus-types"><span class="secno">3.3.4. </span><span class="content">Focus Event Types</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-focus-types"></a></h4>
    <p>The Focus event types are listed below.</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.3.4.1" id="event-type-blur"><span class="secno">3.3.4.1. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="blur" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">blur</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-blur"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>blur</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface

   <section>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="3.4" id="events-inputevents"><span class="secno">3.4. </span><span class="content">Input Events</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-inputevents"></a></h3>
    <p>Input events are sent as notifications whenever the DOM is being updated (or about
	to be updated) as a direct result of a user action (e.g., keyboard input in an editable
	region, deleting or formatting text, ...).</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.4.1" id="interface-inputevent"><span class="secno">3.4.1. </span><span class="content">Interface InputEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#interface-inputevent"></a></h4>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.4.1.1" id="idl-inputevent"><span class="secno">3.4.1.1. </span><span class="content">InputEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#idl-inputevent"></a></h5>
    <p class="intro-dom">Introduced in DOM Level 3</p>
<pre class="def highlight idl">[<a class="idl-code" data-link-type="extended-attribute" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#Exposed" id="ref-for-Exposed②"><c- g="">Exposed</c-></a>=<c- n="">Window</c->]
<c- b="">interface</c-> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="interface" data-export="" id="inputevent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">InputEvent</c-></code></dfn> : <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent②⑨"><c- n="">UIEvent</c-></a> {
  <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="InputEvent" data-dfn-type="constructor" data-export="" data-lt="InputEvent(type, eventInitDict)|constructor(type, eventInitDict)|InputEvent(type)|constructor(type)" id="dom-inputevent-inputevent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">constructor</c-></code></dfn>(<a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString②"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="InputEvent/InputEvent(type, eventInitDict), InputEvent/constructor(type, eventInitDict), InputEvent/InputEvent(type), InputEvent/constructor(type)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-inputevent-inputevent-type-eventinitdict-type" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">type</c-></code></dfn>, <c- b="">optional</c-> <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#dictdef-inputeventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-inputeventinit"><c- n="">InputEventInit</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="InputEvent/InputEvent(type, eventInitDict), InputEvent/constructor(type, eventInitDict), InputEvent/InputEvent(type), InputEvent/constructor(type)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-inputevent-inputevent-type-eventinitdict-eventinitdict" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">eventInitDict</c-></code></dfn> = {});
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-USVString" id="ref-for-idl-USVString"><c- b="">USVString</c-></a>? <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="attribute" data-readonly="" data-type="USVString?" href="#dom-inputevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-inputevent-data"><c- g="">data</c-></a>;
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="attribute" data-readonly="" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-inputevent-iscomposing" id="ref-for-dom-inputevent-iscomposing"><c- g="">isComposing</c-></a>;
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString③"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="attribute" data-readonly="" data-type="DOMString" href="#dom-inputevent-inputtype" id="ref-for-dom-inputevent-inputtype"><c- g="">inputType</c-></a>;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="InputEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-inputevent-data" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>data</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-USVString" id="ref-for-idl-USVString①">USVString</a>, readonly, nullable</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>data</code> holds the value of the characters generated by
					an input method. This MAY be a single Unicode character or a
					non-empty sequence of Unicode characters <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-unicode" title="The Unicode Standard">[Unicode]</a>. Characters
					SHOULD be normalized as defined by the Unicode normalization
					form <em>NFC</em>, defined in <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-uax15" title="Unicode Normalization Forms">[UAX15]</a>.
					This attribute MAY contain the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#empty-string" id="ref-for-empty-string">empty string</a>.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value③">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>null</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="InputEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-inputevent-iscomposing" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>isComposing</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①">boolean</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>true</code> if the input event occurs as part of a
					composition session, i.e., after a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart①"><code>compositionstart</code></a> event
					and before the corresponding <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend①"><code>compositionend</code></a> event.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value④">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>false</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="InputEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-inputevent-inputtype" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>inputType</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString④">DOMString</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>inputType</code> contains a string that identifies the type
					of input associated with the event.


      <p>For a list of valid values for this attribute, refer to the
					<a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-input-events" title="Input Events Level 2">[Input-Events]</a> specification.</p>
      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value⑤">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					the empty string <code>""</code>.</p>
    </dd></dl>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.4.1.2" id="idl-inputeventinit"><span class="secno">3.4.1.2. </span><span class="content">InputEventInit</span><a class="self-link" href="#idl-inputeventinit"></a></h5>

    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.4.2" id="events-inputevent-event-order"><span class="secno">3.4.2. </span><span class="content">Input Event Order</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-inputevent-event-order"></a></h4>

    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent①⑤">user agent</a> MUST dispatch this event when the DOM is about

      </td></tr><tr>

       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>

       </th><td><code>Element</code> (specifically: control types such as <code>HTMLInputElement</code>, etc.) or any <code>Element</code> with <code>contenteditable</code> attribute enabled
      </td></tr><tr>

       </th><td>No

         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent③②">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view①①">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window③①"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent③③">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail①①">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#inputevent" id="ref-for-inputevent⑥">InputEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-inputevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-inputevent-data②">data</a></code> : the string containing the data that has been added to the element, which MAY be the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#empty-string" id="ref-for-empty-string①">empty string</a> if the content has been deleted

    </td></tr></tbody></table>

   <section>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5" id="events-keyboardevents"><span class="secno">3.5. </span><span class="content">Keyboard Events</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-keyboardevents"></a></h3>
    <p>Keyboard events are device dependent, i.e., they rely on the capabilities of
	the input devices and how they are mapped in the operating systems. Refer to
	<a href="#keys">Keyboard events and key values</a> for more details,
	including examples on how Keyboard Events are used in combination with
	Composition Events. Depending on the character generation device, keyboard
	events might not be generated.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
	Keyboard events are only one modality of providing textual input. For
	editing scenarios, consider also using the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#inputevent" id="ref-for-inputevent⑧">InputEvent</a></code> as an alternate to
	(or in addition to) keyboard events.
	</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.1" id="interface-keyboardevent"><span class="secno">3.5.1. </span><span class="content">Interface KeyboardEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#interface-keyboardevent"></a></h4>
    <p class="intro-dom">Introduced in this specification</p>
    <p>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑥">KeyboardEvent</a></code> interface provides specific contextual information
		associated with keyboard devices. Each keyboard event references a key
		using a value. Keyboard events are commonly directed at the element that
		has the focus.</p>
    <p>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑦">KeyboardEvent</a></code> interface provides convenient attributes for some
		common modifiers keys: <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-ctrlkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-ctrlkey">ctrlKey</a></code>,
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-shiftkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-shiftkey">shiftKey</a></code>, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-altkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-altkey">altKey</a></code>,
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-metakey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-metakey">metaKey</a></code>. These attributes are equivalent to using the
		method <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate">getModifierState()</a></code> with <code class="keycap">Control</code>,
		<code class="keycap">Shift</code>, <code class="keycap">Alt</code>, or <code class="keycap">Meta</code> respectively.</p>
    <p>To create an instance of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑧">KeyboardEvent</a></code> interface, use the
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑨">KeyboardEvent</a></code> constructor, passing an optional
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-keyboardeventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-keyboardeventinit">KeyboardEventInit</a></code> dictionary.</p>
