  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean⑦"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="attribute" data-readonly="" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-keyboardevent-metakey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-metakey①"><c- g="">metaKey</c-></a>;

  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean⑧"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="attribute" data-readonly="" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-keyboardevent-repeat" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-repeat"><c- g="">repeat</c-></a>;
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean⑨"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="attribute" data-readonly="" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing"><c- g="">isComposing</c-></a>;

  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①⓪"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="method" href="#dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate①"><c- g="">getModifierState</c-></a>(<a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString①②"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent/getModifierState(keyArg)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate-keyarg-keyarg" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">keyArg</c-></code></dfn>);
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="const" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>DOM_KEY_LOCATION_STANDARD</code></dfn>
     </dt><dd>
      
					The key activation MUST NOT be distinguished as the left or
					right version of the key, and (other than the <code class="keycap">NumLock</code>
					key) did not originate from the numeric keypad (or did not
					originate with a virtual key corresponding to the numeric
					keypad).

					
      <p class="example" id="example-911fe244"><a class="self-link" href="#example-911fe244"></a>
					The <code class="keycap">Q</code> key on a PC 101 Key US keyboard.<br>
					The <code class="keycap">NumLock</code> key on a PC 101 Key US keyboard.<br>
					The <code class="keycap">1</code> key on a PC 101 Key US keyboard located in the
					main section of the keyboard.
					</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="const" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>DOM_KEY_LOCATION_LEFT</code></dfn>
     </dt><dd>
      
					The key activated originated from the left key location (when
					there is more than one possible location for this key).

					
      <p class="example" id="example-93f18483"><a class="self-link" href="#example-93f18483"></a>
					The left <code class="keycap">Control</code> key on a PC 101 Key US keyboard.
					</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="const" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>DOM_KEY_LOCATION_RIGHT</code></dfn>
     </dt><dd>
      
					The key activation originated from the right key location (when
					there is more than one possible location for this key).

					
      <p class="example" id="example-39e05464"><a class="self-link" href="#example-39e05464"></a>
					The right <code class="keycap">Shift</code> key on a PC 101 Key US keyboard.
					</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="const" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>DOM_KEY_LOCATION_NUMPAD</code></dfn>
     </dt><dd>
      
					The key activation originated on the numeric keypad or with a
					virtual key corresponding to the numeric keypad (when there is
					more than one possible location for this key). Note that the
					<code class="keycap">NumLock</code> key should always be encoded with a
					<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location①">location</a></code> of
					<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard①">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_STANDARD</a></code>.

					
      <p class="example" id="example-cd3aecaf"><a class="self-link" href="#example-cd3aecaf"></a>
					The <code class="keycap">1</code> key on a PC 101 Key US keyboard located on the
					numeric pad.
					</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-key" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>key</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString①③">DOMString</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>key</code> holds a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-attribute-value" id="ref-for-key-attribute-value">key attribute value</a> corresponding to
					the key pressed.

					
      <p class="note" role="note">
					The <code>key</code> attribute is not related to the legacy
					<code>keyCode</code> attribute and does not have the same set of
					values.
					</p>
      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value⑥">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>""</code> (the empty string).</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-code" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>code</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString①④">DOMString</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>code</code> holds a string that identifies the physical
					key being pressed. The value is not affected by the current
					keyboard layout or modifier state, so a particular key will
					always return the same value.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value⑦">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>""</code> (the empty string).</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-location" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>location</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long⑤">unsigned long</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location②">location</a></code> attribute contains an indication
					of the logical location of the key on the device.


      <p>This attribute MUST be set to one of the DOM_KEY_LOCATION
					constants to indicate the location of a key on the device.</p>
      <p>If a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent①⑦">user agent</a> allows keys to be remapped, then the
					<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location③">location</a></code> value for a remapped key MUST be set
					to a value which is appropriate for the new key. For example, if
					the <code class="code">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-code/#code-ControlLeft">ControlLeft</a>"</code> key is mapped to the <code class="code">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-code/#code-KeyQ">KeyQ</a>"</code> key, then
					the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location④">location</a></code> attribute MUST be set to
					<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard②">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_STANDARD</a></code>. Conversely, if the
					<code class="code">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-code/#code-KeyQ">KeyQ</a>"</code> key is remapped to one of the <code class="keycap">Control</code> keys,
					then the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location⑤">location</a></code> attribute MUST be set to
					either <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left①">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_LEFT</a></code> or
					<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right①">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_RIGHT</a></code>.</p>
      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value⑧">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>0</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-ctrlkey" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>ctrlKey</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①①">boolean</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>true</code> if the <code class="keycap">Control</code> (control) key modifier
					was active.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value⑨">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>false</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-shiftkey" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>shiftKey</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①②">boolean</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>true</code> if the shift (<code class="keycap">Shift</code>) key modifier was
					active.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value①⓪">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>false</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-altkey" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>altKey</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①③">boolean</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>true</code> if the <code class="keycap">Alt</code> (alternative) (or
					<code class="glyph">"Option"</code>) key modifier was active.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value①①">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>false</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-metakey" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>metaKey</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①④">boolean</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>true</code> if the meta (<code class="keycap">Meta</code>) key modifier was
					active.

					
      <p class="note" role="note">
					The <code class="glyph">"Command"</code> (<code class="glyph">"⌘"</code>) key modifier on Macintosh
					systems is represented using this key modifier.
					</p>
      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value①②">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>false</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-repeat" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>repeat</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①⑤">boolean</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>true</code> if the key has been pressed in a sustained
					manner.  Holding down a key MUST result in the repeating the
					events <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown①"><code>keydown</code></a>, <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput③"><code>beforeinput</code></a>, <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input③"><code>input</code></a> in this
					order, at a rate determined by the system configuration. For
					mobile devices which have <em>long-key-press</em> behavior, the
					first key event with a <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-repeat" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-repeat①">repeat</a></code> attribute value
					of <code>true</code> MUST serve as an indication of a
					<em>long-key-press</em>. The length of time that the key MUST be
					pressed in order to begin repeating is configuration-dependent.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value①③">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>false</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>isComposing</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①⑥">boolean</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>true</code> if the key event occurs as part of a
					composition session, i.e., after a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart②"><code>compositionstart</code></a> event
					and before the corresponding <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend②"><code>compositionend</code></a> event.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value①④">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>false</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="method" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>getModifierState(keyArg)</code></dfn>
     </dt><dd>
      
					Queries the state of a modifier using a key value.


      <p>Returns <code>true</code> if it is a modifier key and
					the modifier is activated, <code>false</code> otherwise.</p>
      <dl class="parameters">
       <dt>DOMString keyArg
       </dt><dd>
        
							A modifier key value.  Valid <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#modifier-key" id="ref-for-modifier-key">modifier keys</a> are defined
							in the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#keys-modifier" id="ref-for-keys-modifier">Modifier Keys table</a> in <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-uievents-key" title="UI Events KeyboardEvent key Values">[UIEvents-Key]</a>.

							
        <p class="note" role="note">
							If an application wishes to distinguish between right
							and left modifiers, this information could be deduced
							using keyboard events and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location⑥">location</a></code>.
							</p>
      </dd></dl>
    </dd></dl>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.1.2" id="idl-keyboardeventinit"><span class="secno">3.5.1.2. </span><span class="content">KeyboardEventInit</span><a class="self-link" href="#idl-keyboardeventinit"></a></h5>
<pre class="def highlight idl"><c- b="">dictionary</c-> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dictionary" data-export="" id="dictdef-keyboardeventinit" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">KeyboardEventInit</c-></code></dfn> : <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#dictdef-eventmodifierinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-eventmodifierinit"><c- n="">EventModifierInit</c-></a> {
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString①⑤"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="""" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="DOMString" href="#dom-keyboardeventinit-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardeventinit-key"><c- g="">key</c-></a> = "";
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString①⑥"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="""" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="DOMString" href="#dom-keyboardeventinit-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardeventinit-code"><c- g="">code</c-></a> = "";
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long⑥"><c- b="">unsigned</c-> <c- b="">long</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="0" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="unsigned long" href="#dom-keyboardeventinit-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardeventinit-location"><c- g="">location</c-></a> = 0;
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①⑦"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="false" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-keyboardeventinit-repeat" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardeventinit-repeat"><c- g="">repeat</c-></a> = <c- b="">false</c->;
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①⑧"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="false" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-keyboardeventinit-iscomposing" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardeventinit-iscomposing"><c- g="">isComposing</c-></a> = <c- b="">false</c->;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardeventinit-key" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>key</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString①⑦">DOMString</a>, defaulting to <code>""</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
					Initializes the <code>key</code> attribute of the KeyboardEvent
					object to the unicode character string representing the meaning
					of a key after taking into account all keyboard modifiers
					(such as shift-state). This value is the final effective value
					of the key. If the key is not a printable character, then it
					should be one of the key values defined in <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-uievents-key" title="UI Events KeyboardEvent key Values">[UIEvents-Key]</a>.
				
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardeventinit-code" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>code</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString①⑧">DOMString</a>, defaulting to <code>""</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
					Initializes the <code>code</code> attribute of the KeyboardEvent
					object to the unicode character string representing the key that
					was pressed, ignoring any keyboard modifications such as
					keyboard layout. This value should be one of the code values
					defined in <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-uievents-code" title="UI Events KeyboardEvent code Values">[UIEvents-Code]</a>.
				
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardeventinit-location" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>location</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long⑦">unsigned long</a>, defaulting to <code>0</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					Initializes the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location⑦">location</a></code> attribute of the
					KeyboardEvent object to one of the following location numerical
					constants:


      <ul>
       <li data-md="">
        <p><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard③">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_STANDARD</a></code> (numerical value 0)</p>
       </li><li data-md="">
        <p><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left②">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_LEFT</a></code> (numerical value 1)</p>
       </li><li data-md="">
        <p><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right②">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_RIGHT</a></code> (numerical value 2)</p>
       </li><li data-md="">
        <p><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad①">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_NUMPAD</a></code> (numerical value 3)</p>
      </li></ul>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardeventinit-repeat" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>repeat</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①⑨">boolean</a>, defaulting to <code>false</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
					Initializes the <code>repeat</code> attribute of the
					KeyboardEvent object. This attribute should be set to
					<code>true</code> if the the current KeyboardEvent is considered
					part of a repeating sequence of similar events caused by the
					long depression of any single key, <code>false</code> otherwise.
				
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardeventinit-iscomposing" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>isComposing</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean②⓪">boolean</a>, defaulting to <code>false</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
					Initializes the <code>isComposing</code> attribute of the
					KeyboardEvent object. This attribute should be set to
					<code>true</code> if the event being constructed occurs as part
					of a composition sequence, <code>false</code> otherwise.
				
    </dd></dl>
    <div class="warning">
     
	Legacy keyboard event implementations include three additional attributes,
	<code>keyCode</code>, <code>charCode</code>, and <code>which</code>. The
	<code>keyCode</code> attribute indicates a numeric value associated with a
	particular key on a computer keyboard, while the <code>charCode</code>
	attribute indicates the <abbr title="American Standard Code for
	Information Interchange">ASCII</abbr> value of the character associated
	with that key (which might be the same as the <code>keyCode</code> value)
	and is applicable only to keys that produce a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#character-value" id="ref-for-character-value">character value</a>.


     <p>In practice, <code>keyCode</code> and <code>charCode</code> are inconsistent
	across platforms and even the same implementation on different operating
	systems or using different localizations. This specification does not define
	values for either <code>keyCode</code> or <code>charCode</code>, or behavior
	for <code>charCode</code>. In conforming UI Events implementations, content
	authors can instead use <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key③">key</a></code> and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code③">code</a></code>.</p>
     <p><em>For more information, see the informative appendix on
	<a href="#legacy-key-attributes">Legacy key attributes</a>.</em></p>
    </div>
    <p class="note" role="note">
	For compatibility with existing content, virtual keyboards, such as software
	keyboards on screen-based input devices, are expected to produce the normal
	range of keyboard events, even though they do not possess physical keys.
	</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
	In some implementations or system configurations, some key events, or their
	values, might be suppressed by the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime">IME</a> in use.
	</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.2" id="events-keyboard-key-location"><span class="secno">3.5.2. </span><span class="content">Keyboard Event Key Location</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-keyboard-key-location"></a></h4>
    <p>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location⑧">location</a></code> attribute can be used to disambiguate
		between <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key④">key</a></code> values that can be generated by different
		physical keys on the keyboard, for example, the left and right
		<code class="keycap">Shift</code> key or the physical arrow keys vs. the numpad arrow keys
		(when <code class="keycap">NumLock</code> is off).</p>
    <p>The following table defines the valid <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location⑨">location</a></code> values
		for the special keys that have more than one location on the keyboard:</p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <th><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent①⓪">KeyboardEvent</a></code> . <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key⑤">key</a></code>
       </th><th>Valid <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location①⓪">location</a></code> values
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td><code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Shift">Shift</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Control">Control</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Alt">Alt</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Meta">Meta</a>"</code>
       </td><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left③">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_LEFT</a></code>, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right③">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_RIGHT</a></code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td><code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-ArrowDown">ArrowDown</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-ArrowLeft">ArrowLeft</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-ArrowRight">ArrowRight</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-ArrowUp">ArrowUp</a>"</code>
       </td><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard④">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_STANDARD</a></code>, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad②">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_NUMPAD</a></code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td><code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-End">End</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Home">Home</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-PageDown">PageDown</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-PageUp">PageUp</a>"</code>
       </td><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard⑤">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_STANDARD</a></code>, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad③">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_NUMPAD</a></code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td><code class="key">"0"</code>, <code class="key">"1"</code>, <code class="key">"2"</code>, <code class="key">"2"</code>, <code class="key">"4"</code>, <code class="key">"5"</code>, <code class="key">"6"</code>, <code class="key">"7"</code>, <code class="key">"8"</code>, <code class="key">"9"</code>, <code class="key">"."</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Enter">Enter</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"+"</code>, <code class="key">"-"</code>, <code class="key">"*"</code>, <code class="key">"/"</code>
       </td><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard⑥">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_STANDARD</a></code>, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad④">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_NUMPAD</a></code>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>For all other keys not listed in this table, the
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location①①">location</a></code> attribute MUST always be set to
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard⑦">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_STANDARD</a></code>.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.3" id="event-modifier-initializers"><span class="secno">3.5.3. </span><span class="content">Event Modifier Initializers</span><a class="self-link" href="#event-modifier-initializers"></a></h4>
    <p>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent①">MouseEvent</a></code> and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent①①">KeyboardEvent</a></code> interfaces share a set of
		keyboard modifier attributes and support a mechanism for retrieving
		additional modifier states. The following dictionary enables authors to
		initialize keyboard modifier attributes of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent②">MouseEvent</a></code> and
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent①②">KeyboardEvent</a></code> interfaces, as well as the additional modifier states
		queried via <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate②">getModifierState()</a></code>. The steps for
		constructing mouse events using this dictionary are defined in the
		<a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-pointerevents4" title="Pointer Events">[pointerevents4]</a> specification.</p>
<pre class="def highlight idl"><c- b="">dictionary</c-> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dictionary" data-export="" id="dictdef-eventmodifierinit" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">EventModifierInit</c-></code></dfn> : <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#dictdef-uieventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-uieventinit⑤"><c- n="">UIEventInit</c-></a> {

  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean②②"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="false" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-eventmodifierinit-shiftkey" id="ref-for-dom-eventmodifierinit-shiftkey"><c- g="">shiftKey</c-></a> = <c- b="">false</c->;

  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean②⑤"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="false" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-eventmodifierinit-modifieraltgraph" id="ref-for-dom-eventmodifierinit-modifieraltgraph"><c- g="">modifierAltGraph</c-></a> = <c- b="">false</c->;
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean②⑥"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="false" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-eventmodifierinit-modifiercapslock" id="ref-for-dom-eventmodifierinit-modifiercapslock"><c- g="">modifierCapsLock</c-></a> = <c- b="">false</c->;
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean②⑦"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="false" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-eventmodifierinit-modifierfn" id="ref-for-dom-eventmodifierinit-modifierfn"><c- g="">modifierFn</c-></a> = <c- b="">false</c->;
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean②⑧"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="false" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-eventmodifierinit-modifierfnlock" id="ref-for-dom-eventmodifierinit-modifierfnlock"><c- g="">modifierFnLock</c-></a> = <c- b="">false</c->;

  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean③②"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="false" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-eventmodifierinit-modifiersuper" id="ref-for-dom-eventmodifierinit-modifiersuper"><c- g="">modifierSuper</c-></a> = <c- b="">false</c->;
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean③③"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="false" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="boolean" href="#dom-eventmodifierinit-modifiersymbol" id="ref-for-dom-eventmodifierinit-modifiersymbol"><c- g="">modifierSymbol</c-></a> = <c- b="">false</c->;

};

    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="EventModifierInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" id="dom-eventmodifierinit-ctrlkey" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>ctrlKey</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean③⑤">boolean</a>, defaulting to <code>false</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
      
				Initializes the <code>ctrlKey</code> attribute of the
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent③">MouseEvent</a></code> or <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent①③">KeyboardEvent</a></code>
				objects to <code>true</code> if the <code class="keycap">Control</code>
				key modifier is to be considered active,
				<code>false</code> otherwise.


      <p>When <code>true</code>, implementations must also initialize the event object’s key modifier
				state such that calls to the
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent-getmodifierstate" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-getmodifierstate">getModifierState()</a></code> or
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate③">getModifierState()</a></code>
				when provided with the parameter <code class="keycap">Control</code>
				must return <code>true</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="EventModifierInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" id="dom-eventmodifierinit-shiftkey" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>shiftKey</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean③⑥">boolean</a>, defaulting to <code>false</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
      
				Initializes the <code>shiftKey</code> attribute of the
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent④">MouseEvent</a></code> or <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent①④">KeyboardEvent</a></code>
				objects to <code>true</code> if the <code class="keycap">Shift</code>
				key modifier is to be considered active, <code>false</code> otherwise.


      <p>When <code>true</code>, implementations must also initialize the event object’s key modifier
				state such that calls to the
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent-getmodifierstate" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-getmodifierstate①">getModifierState()</a></code> or
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate④">getModifierState()</a></code>
				when provided with the parameter <code class="keycap">Shift</code> must
				return <code>true</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="EventModifierInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" id="dom-eventmodifierinit-altkey" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>altKey</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean③⑦">boolean</a>, defaulting to <code>false</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
      
				Initializes the <code>altKey</code> attribute of the
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent⑤">MouseEvent</a></code> or <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent①⑤">KeyboardEvent</a></code>
				objects to <code>true</code> if the <code class="keycap">Alt</code>
				(alternative) (or <code class="keycap">Option</code>) key modifier
				is to be considered active, <code>false</code> otherwise.


      <p>When <code>true</code>, implementations must also initialize the event object’s key modifier
				state such that calls to the
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent-getmodifierstate" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-getmodifierstate②">getModifierState()</a></code> or
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-getmodifierstate⑤">getModifierState()</a></code>
				when provided with the parameter <code class="keycap">Alt</code> must
				return <code>true</code>.</p>
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="EventModifierInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" id="dom-eventmodifierinit-metakey" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>metaKey</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean③⑧">boolean</a>, defaulting to <code>false</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
