    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.4" id="keyboardevent-algorithms"><span class="secno">3.5.4. </span><span class="content">KeyboardEvent Algorithms</span><a class="self-link" href="#keyboardevent-algorithms"></a></h4>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.4.1" id="keyboardevent-global-state"><span class="secno">3.5.4.1. </span><span class="content">Global State for KeyboardEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#keyboardevent-global-state"></a></h5>
    <h6 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.4.1.1" id="keyboardevent-global-ua"><span class="secno">3.5.4.1.1. </span><span class="content">User Agent-Level State</span><a class="self-link" href="#keyboardevent-global-ua"></a></h6>
    <p>The UA must maintain the following values that are shared for the entire
				User Agent.</p>
    <p>A <dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-export="" id="key-modifier-state" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">key modifier state</dfn> (initially empty) that keeps track of the current
				state of each <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#modifier-key" id="ref-for-modifier-key①">modifier key</a> available on the system.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.5" id="events-keyboard-event-order"><span class="secno">3.5.5. </span><span class="content">Keyboard Event Order</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-keyboard-event-order"></a></h4>
    <p>The keyboard events defined in this specification occur in a set order
		relative to one another, for any given key:</p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><th>Event Type
       </th><th>Notes
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">1
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown②"><code>keydown</code></a>
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">2
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput④"><code>beforeinput</code></a>
       </td><td><em>(only for keys which produce a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#character-value" id="ref-for-character-value①">character value</a>)</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td><em>Any <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#default-action" id="ref-for-default-action">default actions</a> related to this key, such as inserting a character in to the DOM.</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">3
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input④"><code>input</code></a>
       </td><td><em>(only for keys which have updated the DOM)</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td><em>Any events as a result of the key being held for a sustained period (see below).</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">4
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup①"><code>keyup</code></a>
       </td><td>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>If the key is depressed for a sustained period, the following events MAY
		repeat at an environment-dependent rate: </p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><th>Event Type
       </th><th>Notes
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">1
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown③"><code>keydown</code></a>
       </td><td><em>(with <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-repeat" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-repeat②">repeat</a></code> attribute set to <code>true</code>)</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">2
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput⑤"><code>beforeinput</code></a>
       </td><td><em>(only for keys which produce a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#character-value" id="ref-for-character-value②">character value</a>)</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td><em>Any <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#default-action" id="ref-for-default-action①">default actions</a> related to this key, such as inserting a character in to the DOM.</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">3
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input⑤"><code>input</code></a>
       </td><td><em>(only for keys which have updated the DOM)</em>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		Typically, any <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#default-action" id="ref-for-default-action②">default actions</a> associated with any particular key
		are completed before the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup②"><code>keyup</code></a> event is dispatched. This might
		delay the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup③"><code>keyup</code></a> event slightly (though this is not likely to be a
		perceptible delay).
		</p>
    <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#event-target" id="ref-for-event-target①⑧">event target</a> of a key event is the currently focused element
		which is processing the keyboard activity. This is often an HTML
		<code>input</code> element or a textual element which is editable, but
		MAY be an element defined by the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#host-language" id="ref-for-host-language⑦">host language</a> to accept keyboard
		input for non-text purposes, such as the activation of an accelerator
		key or trigger of some other behavior. If no suitable element is in
		focus, the event target will be the HTML <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#body-element" id="ref-for-body-element">body element</a> if
		available, otherwise the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#root-element" id="ref-for-root-element">root element</a>.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#event-target" id="ref-for-event-target①⑨">event target</a> might change between different key events. For
		example, a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown④"><code>keydown</code></a> event for the <code class="keycap">Tab</code> key will likely have
		a different <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#event-target" id="ref-for-event-target②⓪">event target</a> than the  <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup④"><code>keyup</code></a> event on the same
		keystroke.

	</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.6" id="events-keyboard-types"><span class="secno">3.5.6. </span><span class="content">Keyboard Event Types</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-keyboard-types"></a></h4>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.6.1" id="event-type-keydown"><span class="secno">3.5.6.1. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="keydown" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">keydown</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-keydown"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>keydown</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface
       </th><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent①⑦">KeyboardEvent</a></code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Sync / Async
       </th><td>Sync
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Bubbles
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Trusted Targets
       </th><td><code>Element</code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Cancelable
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Composed
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Default action
       </th><td>Varies: <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput⑥"><code>beforeinput</code></a> and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input⑥"><code>input</code></a> events; launch <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system②">text composition system</a>; <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#blur" id="ref-for-blur⑥"><code>blur</code></a> and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#focus" id="ref-for-focus⑧"><code>focus</code></a> events; <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keypress" id="ref-for-keypress①"><code>keypress</code></a> event (if supported); <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior" id="ref-for-eventtarget-activation-behavior①">activation behavior</a>; other event
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Context<br> (trusted events)
       </th><td>
        <ul>
         <li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event②⑥">Event</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target①③">target</a></code> : focused element processing the key event or if no element focused, then the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#body-element" id="ref-for-body-element①">body element</a> if available, otherwise the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#root-element" id="ref-for-root-element①">root element</a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent③⑤">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view①②">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window③②"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent③⑥">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail①②">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent①⑧">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key⑥">key</a></code> : the key value of the key pressed.
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent①⑨">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code④">code</a></code> : the code value associated with the key’s physical placement on the keyboard.
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent②⓪">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location①②">location</a></code> : the location of the key on the device.
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent②①">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-altkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-altkey②">altKey</a></code> : <code>true</code> if <code class="keycap">Alt</code> modifier was active, otherwise <code>false</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent②②">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-shiftkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-shiftkey②">shiftKey</a></code> : <code>true</code> if <code class="keycap">Shift</code> modifier was active, otherwise <code>false</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent②③">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-ctrlkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-ctrlkey②">ctrlKey</a></code> : <code>true</code> if <code class="keycap">Control</code> modifier was active, otherwise <code>false</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent②④">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-metakey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-metakey②">metaKey</a></code> : <code>true</code> if <code class="keycap">Meta</code> modifier was active, otherwise <code>false</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent②⑤">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-repeat" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-repeat③">repeat</a></code> : <code>true</code> if a key has been depressed long enough to trigger key repetition, otherwise <code>false</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent②⑥">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing①">isComposing</a></code> : <code>true</code> if the key event occurs as part of a composition session, otherwise <code>false</code>
        </li></ul>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent①⑧">user agent</a> MUST dispatch this event when a key is pressed
			down. The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown⑤"><code>keydown</code></a> event type is device dependent and relies
			on the capabilities of the input devices and how they are mapped in
			the operating system. This event type MUST be generated after the
			<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#key-mapping" id="ref-for-key-mapping">key mapping</a>. This event type MUST be dispatched before the
			<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput⑦"><code>beforeinput</code></a>, <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input⑦"><code>input</code></a>, and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup⑤"><code>keyup</code></a> events associated
			with the same key.</p>
    <p>The default action of the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown⑥"><code>keydown</code></a> event depends upon the key:</p>
    <ul>
     <li data-md="">
      <p>If the key is associated with a character, the default action
MUST be to dispatch a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput⑧"><code>beforeinput</code></a> event followed by an
<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input⑧"><code>input</code></a> event. In the case where the key which is
associated with multiple characters (such as with a macro or
certain sequences of dead keys), the default action MUST be to
dispatch one set of <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput⑨"><code>beforeinput</code></a> / <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input⑨"><code>input</code></a> events for
each character</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>If the key is associated with a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system③">text composition system</a>,
the default action MUST be to launch that system</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>If the key is the <code class="keycap">Tab</code> key, the default action MUST be
to shift the document focus from the currently focused element
(if any) to the new focused element, as described in
<a href="#events-focusevent">Focus Event Types</a></p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>If the key is the <code class="keycap">Enter</code> or <code class="keycap"> </code> (Space) key and the
current focus is on a state-changing element, the default action
MUST be to dispatch a <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="event" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dfn-click" id="ref-for-dfn-click"><code>click</code></a> event, and a
<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#domactivate" id="ref-for-domactivate"><code>DOMActivate</code></a> event if that event type is supported by the
<a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent①⑨">user agent</a>.</p>
    </li></ul>
    <p>If this event is canceled, the associated event types MUST NOT be
			dispatched, and the associated actions MUST NOT be performed.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
			The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown⑦"><code>keydown</code></a> and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup⑥"><code>keyup</code></a> events are traditionally
			associated with detecting any key, not just those which produce a
			<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#character-value" id="ref-for-character-value③">character value</a>.
			</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.5.6.2" id="event-type-keyup"><span class="secno">3.5.6.2. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="keyup" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">keyup</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-keyup"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>keyup</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface
       </th><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent②⑦">KeyboardEvent</a></code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Sync / Async
       </th><td>Sync
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Bubbles
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Trusted Targets
       </th><td><code>Element</code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Cancelable
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Composed
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Default action
       </th><td>None
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Context<br> (trusted events)
       </th><td>
        <ul>
         <li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event②⑦">Event</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target①④">target</a></code> : focused element processing the key event or if no element focused, then the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#body-element" id="ref-for-body-element②">body element</a> if available, otherwise the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#root-element" id="ref-for-root-element②">root element</a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent③⑦">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view①③">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window③③"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent③⑧">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail①③">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent②⑧">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key⑦">key</a></code> : the key value of the key pressed.
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent②⑨">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code⑤">code</a></code> : the code value associated with the key’s physical placement on the keyboard.
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent③⓪">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location①③">location</a></code> : the location of the key on the device.
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent③①">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-altkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-altkey③">altKey</a></code> : <code>true</code> if <code class="keycap">Alt</code> modifier was active, otherwise <code>false</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent③②">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-shiftkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-shiftkey③">shiftKey</a></code> : <code>true</code> if <code class="keycap">Shift</code> modifier was active, otherwise <code>false</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent③③">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-ctrlkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-ctrlkey③">ctrlKey</a></code> : <code>true</code> if <code class="keycap">Control</code> modifier was active, otherwise <code>false</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent③④">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-metakey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-metakey③">metaKey</a></code> : <code>true</code> if <code class="keycap">Meta</code> modifier was active, otherwise <code>false</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent③⑤">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-repeat" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-repeat④">repeat</a></code> : <code>true</code> if a key has been depressed long enough to trigger key repetition, otherwise <code>false</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent③⑥">KeyboardEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing②">isComposing</a></code> : <code>true</code> if the key event occurs as part of a composition session, otherwise <code>false</code>
        </li></ul>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent②⓪">user agent</a> MUST dispatch this event when a key is released.
			The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup⑦"><code>keyup</code></a> event type is device dependent and relies on the
			capabilities of the input devices and how they are mapped in the
			operating system. This event type MUST be generated after the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#key-mapping" id="ref-for-key-mapping①">key
			mapping</a>. This event type MUST be dispatched after the
			<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown⑧"><code>keydown</code></a>, <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput①⓪"><code>beforeinput</code></a>, and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input①⓪"><code>input</code></a> events
			associated with the same key.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
			The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown⑨"><code>keydown</code></a> and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup⑧"><code>keyup</code></a> events are traditionally
			associated with detecting any key, not just those which produce a
			<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#character-value" id="ref-for-character-value④">character value</a>.
			</p>
   </section>
   <section>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6" id="events-compositionevents"><span class="secno">3.6. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="composition-events" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">Composition Events</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#events-compositionevents"></a></h3>
    <p>Composition Events provide a means for inputing text in a supplementary or
	alternate manner than by Keyboard Events, in order to allow the use of
	characters that might not be commonly available on keyboard. For example,
	Composition Events might be used to add accents to characters despite their
	absence from standard US keyboards, to build up logograms of many Asian
	languages from their base components or categories, to select word choices
	from a combination of key presses on a mobile device keyboard, or to convert
	voice commands into text using a speech recognition processor. Refer to
	<a href="#keys">§ 4 Keyboard events and key values</a> for examples on how Composition Events are used in combination
	with keyboard events.</p>
    <p>Conceptually, a composition session consists of one <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart③"><code>compositionstart</code></a>
	event, one or more <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate①"><code>compositionupdate</code></a> events, and one
	<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend③"><code>compositionend</code></a> event, with the value of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data">data</a></code>
	attribute persisting between each <q>stage</q> of this event chain during
	each session.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note"><strong>Note:</strong>
	While a composition session is active, keyboard events can be dispatched to
	the DOM if the keyboard is the input device used with the composition
	session. See the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart④"><code>compositionstart</code></a> event details and
	<a href="#keys-IME">IME section</a> for relevent event ordering.
	</p>
    <p>Not all <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime①">IME</a> systems or devices expose the necessary data to the DOM,
	so the active composition string (the <q>Reading Window</q> or <q>candidate
	selection menu option</q>) might not be available through this interface, in
	which case the selection MAY be represented by the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#empty-string" id="ref-for-empty-string②">empty string</a>.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.1" id="interface-compositionevent"><span class="secno">3.6.1. </span><span class="content">Interface CompositionEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#interface-compositionevent"></a></h4>
    <p class="intro-dom">Introduced in this specification</p>
    <p>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent③">CompositionEvent</a></code> interface provides specific contextual
		information associated with Composition Events.</p>
    <p>To create an instance of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent④">CompositionEvent</a></code> interface,
		use the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent⑤">CompositionEvent</a></code> constructor, passing an optional
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-compositioneventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-compositioneventinit">CompositionEventInit</a></code> dictionary.</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.1.1" id="idl-compositionevent"><span class="secno">3.6.1.1. </span><span class="content">CompositionEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#idl-compositionevent"></a></h5>
<pre class="def highlight idl">[<a class="idl-code" data-link-type="extended-attribute" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#Exposed" id="ref-for-Exposed④"><c- g="">Exposed</c-></a>=<c- n="">Window</c->]
<c- b="">interface</c-> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="interface" data-export="" id="compositionevent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">CompositionEvent</c-></code></dfn> : <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent③⑨"><c- n="">UIEvent</c-></a> {
  <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="CompositionEvent" data-dfn-type="constructor" data-export="" data-lt="CompositionEvent(type, eventInitDict)|constructor(type, eventInitDict)|CompositionEvent(type)|constructor(type)" id="dom-compositionevent-compositionevent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">constructor</c-></code></dfn>(<a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString①⑨"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="CompositionEvent/CompositionEvent(type, eventInitDict), CompositionEvent/constructor(type, eventInitDict), CompositionEvent/CompositionEvent(type), CompositionEvent/constructor(type)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-compositionevent-compositionevent-type-eventinitdict-type" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">type</c-></code></dfn>, <c- b="">optional</c-> <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#dictdef-compositioneventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-compositioneventinit①"><c- n="">CompositionEventInit</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="CompositionEvent/CompositionEvent(type, eventInitDict), CompositionEvent/constructor(type, eventInitDict), CompositionEvent/CompositionEvent(type), CompositionEvent/constructor(type)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-compositionevent-compositionevent-type-eventinitdict-eventinitdict" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">eventInitDict</c-></code></dfn> = {});
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-USVString" id="ref-for-idl-USVString②"><c- b="">USVString</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="attribute" data-readonly="" data-type="USVString" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data①"><c- g="">data</c-></a>;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="CompositionEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-compositionevent-data" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>data</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-USVString" id="ref-for-idl-USVString③">USVString</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
					<code>data</code> holds the value of the characters generated by
					an input method. This MAY be a single Unicode character or a
					non-empty sequence of Unicode characters <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-unicode" title="The Unicode Standard">[Unicode]</a>. Characters
					SHOULD be normalized as defined by the Unicode normalization
					form <em>NFC</em>, defined in <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-uax15" title="Unicode Normalization Forms">[UAX15]</a>. This
					attribute MAY be the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#empty-string" id="ref-for-empty-string③">empty string</a>.


      <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#un-initialized-value" id="ref-for-un-initialized-value①⑤">un-initialized value</a> of this attribute MUST be
					<code>""</code> (the empty string).</p>
    </dd></dl>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.1.2" id="idl-compositioneventinit"><span class="secno">3.6.1.2. </span><span class="content">CompositionEventInit</span><a class="self-link" href="#idl-compositioneventinit"></a></h5>
<pre class="def highlight idl"><c- b="">dictionary</c-> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dictionary" data-export="" id="dictdef-compositioneventinit" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">CompositionEventInit</c-></code></dfn> : <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="#dictdef-uieventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-uieventinit⑥"><c- n="">UIEventInit</c-></a> {
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString②⓪"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="""" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="DOMString" href="#dom-compositioneventinit-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositioneventinit-data"><c- g="">data</c-></a> = "";
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="CompositionEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-export="" id="dom-compositioneventinit-data" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>data</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString②①">DOMString</a>, defaulting to <code>""</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
					Initializes the <code>data</code> attribute of the
					CompositionEvent object to the characters generated by the IME
					composition.
				
    </dd></dl>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.2" id="events-composition-order"><span class="secno">3.6.2. </span><span class="content">Composition Event Order</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-composition-order"></a></h4>
    <p>The Composition Events defined in this specification MUST occur in the following set order relative to one another:</p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><th>Event Type
       </th><th>Notes
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">1
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart⑤"><code>compositionstart</code></a>
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">2
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate②"><code>compositionupdate</code></a>
       </td><td>Multiple events
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">3
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend④"><code>compositionend</code></a>
       </td><td>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.3" id="events-composition-handwriting"><span class="secno">3.6.3. </span><span class="content">Handwriting Recognition Systems</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-composition-handwriting"></a></h4>
    <p>The following example describes a possible sequence of events when
		composing a text passage <q>text</q> with a handwriting recognition
		system, such as on a pen tablet, as modeled using Composition Events.</p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><th>Event Type
       </th><th style="text-align:center"><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent⑥">CompositionEvent</a></code><br> <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data②">data</a></code>
       </th><th>Notes
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">1
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart⑥"><code>compositionstart</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center"><code>""</code>
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">
       </td><td><em>User writes word on tablet surface</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">2
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate③"><code>compositionupdate</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center"><code>"test"</code>
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">
       </td><td><em>User rejects first word-match suggestion, selects different match</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">3
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate④"><code>compositionupdate</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center"><code>"text"</code>
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">4
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend⑤"><code>compositionend</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center"><code>"text"</code>
       </td><td>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.4" id="events-composition-canceling"><span class="secno">3.6.4. </span><span class="content">Canceling Composition Events</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-composition-canceling"></a></h4>
    <p>If a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown①⓪"><code>keydown</code></a> event is canceled then any Composition Events that
		would have fired as a result of that <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown①①"><code>keydown</code></a> SHOULD not be
		dispatched:</p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><th>Event Type
       </th><th>Notes
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">1
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown①②"><code>keydown</code></a>
       </td><td>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#default-action" id="ref-for-default-action③">default action</a> is prevented, e.g., by invoking <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-preventdefault" id="ref-for-dom-event-preventdefault①">preventDefault()</a></code>.
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td><em>No Composition Events are dispatched</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">2
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup⑨"><code>keyup</code></a>
       </td><td>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>If the initial <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart⑦"><code>compositionstart</code></a> event is canceled then the text
		composition session SHOULD be terminated. Regardless of whether or not
		the composition session is terminated, the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend⑥"><code>compositionend</code></a> event
		MUST be sent.</p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><th>Event Type
       </th><th>Notes
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">1
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown①③"><code>keydown</code></a>
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">2
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart⑧"><code>compositionstart</code></a>
       </td><td>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#default-action" id="ref-for-default-action④">default action</a> is prevented, e.g., by invoking <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-preventdefault" id="ref-for-dom-event-preventdefault②">preventDefault()</a></code>.
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td><em>No Composition Events are dispatched</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">3
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend⑦"><code>compositionend</code></a>
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">4
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup①⓪"><code>keyup</code></a>
       </td><td>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.5" id="events-composition-key-events"><span class="secno">3.6.5. </span><span class="content">Key Events During Composition</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-composition-key-events"></a></h4>
    <p>During the composition session, <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown①④"><code>keydown</code></a> and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup①①"><code>keyup</code></a> events
		MUST still be sent, and these events MUST have the
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing③">isComposing</a></code> attribute set to <code>true</code>.</p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><th>Event Type
       </th><th style="text-align:center"><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent③⑦">KeyboardEvent</a></code><br> <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-iscomposing④">isComposing</a></code>
       </th><th>Notes
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">1
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown①⑤"><code>keydown</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">false
       </td><td>This is the key event that initiates the composition.
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">2
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart⑨"><code>compositionstart</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">3
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate⑤"><code>compositionupdate</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">4
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup①②"><code>keyup</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">true
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>...
       </td><td style="text-align:center">
       </td><td>Any key events sent during the composition session MUST have <code>isComposing</code> set to <code>true</code>.
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">5
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown①⑥"><code>keydown</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">true
       </td><td>This is the key event that exits the composition.
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">6
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend⑧"><code>compositionend</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">7
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup①③"><code>keyup</code></a>
       </td><td style="text-align:center">false
       </td><td>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.6" id="events-composition-input-events"><span class="secno">3.6.6. </span><span class="content">Input Events During Composition</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-composition-input-events"></a></h4>
    <p>During the composition session, the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate⑥"><code>compositionupdate</code></a> MUST be
		dispatched after the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput①①"><code>beforeinput</code></a> is sent, but before the
		<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input①①"><code>input</code></a> event is sent.</p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><th>Event Type
       </th><th>Notes
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">1
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput①②"><code>beforeinput</code></a>
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">2
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate⑦"><code>compositionupdate</code></a>
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td><em>Any DOM updates occur at this point.</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">3
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input①②"><code>input</code></a>
       </td><td>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		Most IMEs do not support canceling updates during a composition session.
		</p>
    <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput①③"><code>beforeinput</code></a> and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input①③"><code>input</code></a> events are sent along with the
		<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate⑧"><code>compositionupdate</code></a> event whenever the DOM is updated as part of
		the composition. Since there are no DOM updates associated with the
		<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend⑨"><code>compositionend</code></a> event, <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput①④"><code>beforeinput</code></a> and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input①④"><code>input</code></a> events
		should not be sent at that time.</p>
    <table class="event-sequence-table">
     <thead>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><th>Event Type
       </th><th>Notes
     </th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr>
       <td class="cell-number">1
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput①⑤"><code>beforeinput</code></a>
       </td><td><em> Canceling this will prevent the DOM update and the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input①⑤"><code>input</code></a> event.</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">2
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate⑨"><code>compositionupdate</code></a>
       </td><td>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">
       </td><td>
       </td><td><em>Any DOM updates occur at this point.</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">3
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input①⑥"><code>input</code></a>
       </td><td><em>Sent only if the DOM was updated.</em>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <td class="cell-number">4
       </td><td><a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend①⓪"><code>compositionend</code></a>
       </td><td>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.7" id="events-composition-types"><span class="secno">3.6.7. </span><span class="content">Composition Event Types</span><a class="self-link" href="#events-composition-types"></a></h4>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.7.1" id="event-type-compositionstart"><span class="secno">3.6.7.1. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="compositionstart" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">compositionstart</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-compositionstart"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>compositionstart</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface
       </th><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent⑦">CompositionEvent</a></code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Sync / Async
       </th><td>Sync
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Bubbles
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Trusted Targets
       </th><td><code>Element</code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Cancelable
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Composed
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Default action
       </th><td>Start a new composition session when a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system④">text composition system</a> is enabled
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Context<br> (trusted events)
       </th><td>
        <ul>
         <li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event②⑧">Event</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target①⑤">target</a></code> : focused element processing the composition
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④⓪">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view①④">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window③④"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④①">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail①④">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent⑧">CompositionEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data③">data</a></code> : the original string being edited, otherwise the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#empty-string" id="ref-for-empty-string④">empty string</a>
        </li></ul>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent②①">user agent</a> MUST dispatch this event when a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system⑤">text
			composition system</a> is enabled and a new composition session is
			about to begin (or has begun, depending on the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system⑥">text composition
			system</a>) in preparation for composing a passage of text. This
			event type is device-dependent, and MAY rely upon the capabilities
			of the text conversion system and how it is mapped into the
			operating system. When a keyboard is used to feed an input method
			editor, this event type is generated after a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown①⑦"><code>keydown</code></a> event,
			but speech or handwriting recognition systems MAY send this event
			type without keyboard events.  Some implementations MAY populate the
			<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data④">data</a></code> attribute of the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart①⓪"><code>compositionstart</code></a>
			event with the text currently selected in the document (for editing
			and replacement). Otherwise, the value of the
			<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data⑤">data</a></code> attribute MUST be  the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#empty-string" id="ref-for-empty-string⑤">empty string</a>.</p>
    <p>This event MUST be dispatched immediately before a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system⑦">text
			composition system</a> begins a new composition session, and before
			the DOM is modified due to the composition process. The default
			action of this event is for the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system⑧">text composition system</a> to
			start a new composition session. If this event is canceled, the
			<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system⑨">text composition system</a> SHOULD discard the current
			composition session.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
			Canceling the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionstart" id="ref-for-compositionstart①①"><code>compositionstart</code></a> <em>event type</em> is
			distinct from canceling the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system①⓪">text composition system</a> itself
			(e.g., by hitting a cancel button or closing an <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime②">IME</a> window).
			</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
			Some IMEs do not support cancelling an in-progress composition
			session (e.g., such as GTK which doesn’t presently have such an
			API). In these cases, calling <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-preventdefault" id="ref-for-dom-event-preventdefault③">preventDefault()</a></code> will not
			stop this event’s default action.
			</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.7.2" id="event-type-compositionupdate"><span class="secno">3.6.7.2. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="compositionupdate" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">compositionupdate</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-compositionupdate"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>compositionupdate</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface
       </th><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent⑨">CompositionEvent</a></code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Sync / Async
       </th><td>Sync
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Bubbles
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Trusted Targets
       </th><td><code>Element</code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Cancelable
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Composed
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Default action
       </th><td>None
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Context<br> (trusted events)
       </th><td>
        <ul>
         <li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event②⑨">Event</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target①⑥">target</a></code> : focused element processing the composition, <code>null</code> if not accessible
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④②">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view①⑤">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window③⑤"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④③">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail①⑤">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent①⓪">CompositionEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data⑥">data</a></code> : the string comprising the current results of the composition session, which MAY be the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#empty-string" id="ref-for-empty-string⑥">empty string</a> if the content has been deleted
        </li></ul>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent②②">user agent</a> SHOULD dispatch this event during a composition
			session when a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system①①">text composition system</a> updates its active
			text passage with a new character, which is reflected in the string
			in <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data⑦">data</a></code>.</p>
    <p>In <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system①②">text composition systems</a> which keep the ongoing
			composition in sync with the input control, the
			<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate①⓪"><code>compositionupdate</code></a> event MUST be dispatched before the control
			is updated.</p>
    <p>Some <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system①③">text composition systems</a> might not expose this
			information to the DOM, in which case this event will not fire
			during the composition process.</p>
    <p>If the composition session is canceled, this event will be fired
			immediately before the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend①①"><code>compositionend</code></a> event, and the
			<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data⑧">data</a></code> attribute will be set to the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#empty-string" id="ref-for-empty-string⑦">empty
			string</a>.</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="3.6.7.3" id="event-type-compositionend"><span class="secno">3.6.7.3. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="compositionend" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">compositionend</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#event-type-compositionend"></a></h5>
    <table class="event-definition">
     <tbody>
      <tr>
       <th>Type
       </th><td><strong><code>compositionend</code></strong>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Interface
       </th><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent①①">CompositionEvent</a></code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Sync / Async
       </th><td>Sync
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Bubbles
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Trusted Targets
       </th><td><code>Element</code>
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Cancelable
       </th><td>No
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Composed
       </th><td>Yes
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Default action
       </th><td>None
      </td></tr><tr>
       <th>Context<br> (trusted events)
       </th><td>
        <ul>
         <li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event③⓪">Event</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-target" id="ref-for-dom-event-target①⑦">target</a></code> : focused element processing the composition
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④④">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view①⑥">view</a></code> : <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-3/#window" id="ref-for-window③⑥"><code>Window</code></a>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④⑤">UIEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail①⑥">detail</a></code> : <code>0</code>
         </li><li><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent①②">CompositionEvent</a></code>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data⑨">data</a></code> : the string comprising the final result of the composition session, which MAY be the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#empty-string" id="ref-for-empty-string⑧">empty string</a> if the content has been deleted or if the composition process has been canceled
        </li></ul>
    </td></tr></tbody></table>
    <p>A <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent②③">user agent</a> MUST dispatch this event when a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system①④">text
			composition system</a> completes or cancels the current composition
			session, and the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend①②"><code>compositionend</code></a> event MUST be dispatched
			after the control is updated.</p>
    <p>This event is dispatched immediately after the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#text-composition-system" id="ref-for-text-composition-system①⑤">text composition
			system</a> completes the composition session (e.g., the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime③">IME</a>
			is closed, minimized, switched out of focus, or otherwise dismissed,
			and the focus switched back to the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent②④">user agent</a>).</p>
   </section>
   <section>
    <h2 class="heading settled" data-level="4" id="keys"><span class="secno">4. </span><span class="content">Keyboard events and key values</span><a class="self-link" href="#keys"></a></h2>
    <p>This section contains necessary information regarding keyboard events:</p>
    <ul>
     <li data-md="">
      <p>Explanation of keyboard layout, mapping, and key values.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>Relations between keys, such as <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#dead-key" id="ref-for-dead-key">dead keys</a> or modifiers keys.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>Relations between keyboard events and their default actions.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>The set of <code>key</code> values, and guidelines on how to extend this set.</p>
    </li></ul>
    <p class="note" role="note">
This section uses Serbian and Kanji characters which could be misrepresented or
unavailable in the PDF version or printed version of this specification.
</p>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="4.1" id="keyboard-input"><span class="secno">4.1. </span><span class="content">Keyboard Input</span><a class="self-link" href="#keyboard-input"></a></h3>
    <p><em>This section is non-normative</em></p>
    <p>The relationship of each key to the complete keyboard has three separate
	aspects, each of which vary among different models and configurations of
	keyboards, particularly for locale-specific reasons:</p>
    <ul>
     <li data-md="">
      <p><strong>Mechanical layout:</strong> the dimensions, size, and placement
of the physical keys on the keyboard</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p><strong>Visual markings:</strong> the labels (or <em>legends</em>) that
mark each key</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p><strong>Functional mapping:</strong> the abstract key-value association
of each key.</p>
    </li></ul>
    <p>This specification only defines the functional mapping, in terms of
	<a href="#keys-keyvalues"><code>key</code></a> values and
	<a href="#keys-codevalues"><code>code</code></a> values,
	but briefly describes <a href="#key-legends">key legends</a>
	for background.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="4.1.1" id="key-legends"><span class="secno">4.1.1. </span><span class="content">Key Legends</span><a class="self-link" href="#key-legends"></a></h4>
    <p><em>This section is informative</em></p>
    <p>The key legend is the visual marking that is printed or embossed on the
		<em>key cap</em> (the rectangular "cap" that covers the mechanical
		switch for the key). These markings normally consist of one or more
		characters that a keystroke on that key will produce (such as <code class="glyph">"G"</code>,
		<code class="glyph">"8"</code>, or <code class="glyph">"ш"</code>), or names or symbols which indicate that key’s
		function (such as an upward-pointing arrow <code class="glyph">"⇧"</code> indicating
		<code class="keycap">Shift</code>, or the string <code>"Enter"</code>). Keys are often
		referred to by this marking (e.g., <q>Press the <code>"Shift"</code> and
		<code>"G"</code> keys.</q>). Note, however, that the visual appearance
		of the key has no bearing on its digital representation, and in many
		configurations may be completely inaccurate. Even the control and
		function keys, such as <code class="keycap">Enter</code>, may be mapped to different
		functionality, or even mapped as character keys.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		Many keyboards contain keys that do not normally produce any characters,
		even though the symbol might have a Unicode equivalent. For example, the
		<code class="keycap">Shift</code> key might bear the symbol <code class="glyph">"⇧"</code>, which has the
		Unicode code point <code class="unicode">U+21E7</code>, but
		pressing the <code class="keycap">Shift</code> key will not produce this character value,
		and there is no Unicode code point for <code class="keycap">Shift</code>.
		</p>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="4.2" id="keys-codevalues"><span class="secno">4.2. </span><span class="content">Key codes</span><a class="self-link" href="#keys-codevalues"></a></h3>
    <p>A key <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code⑥">code</a></code> is an attribute of a keyboard event that can be
	used to identify the physical key associated with the keyboard event. It is
	similar to USB Usage IDs in that it provides a low-level value (similar to a
	scancode) that is vendor-neutral.</p>
    <p>The primary purpose of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code⑦">code</a></code> attribute is to provide a
	consistent and coherent way to identify keys based on their physical
	location. In addition, it also provides a stable name (unaffected by the
	current keyboard state) that uniquely identifies each key on the keyboard.</p>
    <p>The list of valid <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code⑧">code</a></code> values is defined in the
	<a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-uievents-code" title="UI Events KeyboardEvent code Values">[UIEvents-Code]</a>.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="4.2.1" id="code-motivation"><span class="secno">4.2.1. </span><span class="content">Motivation for the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code⑨">code</a></code> Attribute</span><a class="self-link" href="#code-motivation"></a></h4>
    <p>The standard PC keyboard has a set of keys (which we refer to as
		<em>writing system keys</em>) that generate different
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key⑧">key</a></code> values based on the current keyboard layout
		selected by the user. This situation makes it difficult to write code
		that detects keys based on their physical location since the code would
		need to know which layout is in effect in order to know which
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key⑨">key</a></code> values to check for. A real-world example of this
		is a game that wants to use the <code class="glyph">"W"</code>, <code class="glyph">"A"</code>, <code class="glyph">"S"</code> and
		<code class="glyph">"D"</code> keys to control player movement. The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code①⓪">code</a></code>
		attribute solves this problem by providing a stable value to check that
		is <em>not affected by the current keyboard layout</em>.</p>
    <p>In addition, the values in the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key①⓪">key</a></code> attribute depend as
		well on the current keyboard state. Because of this, the order in which
		keys are pressed and released in relation to modifier keys can affect
		the values stored in the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key①①">key</a></code> attribute. The
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code①①">code</a></code> attribute solves this problem by providing a
		stable value that is <em>not affected by the current keyboard state</em>.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="4.2.2" id="relationship-between-key-code"><span class="secno">4.2.2. </span><span class="content">The Relationship Between <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key①②">key</a></code> and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code①②">code</a></code></span><a class="self-link" href="#relationship-between-key-code"></a></h4>
    <dl>
     <dt><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key①③">key</a></code>
     </dt><dd>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key①④">key</a></code> attribute is intended for users who
				are interested in the meaning of the key being pressed, taking
				into account the current keyboard layout (and IME;
				<a href="#keys-dead">dead keys</a> are given a unique
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key①⑤">key</a></code> value). Example use case: Detecting
				modified keys or bare modifier keys (e.g., to perform an action
				in response to a keyboard shortcut).
			
     </dd><dt><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code①③">code</a></code>
     </dt><dd>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code①④">code</a></code> attribute is intended for users who
				are interested in the key that was pressed by the user, without
				any layout modifications applied. Example use case: Detecting
				WASD keys (e.g., for movement controls in a game) or trapping
				all keys (e.g., in a remote desktop client to send all keys to
				the remote host).
			
    </dd></dl>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="4.2.3" id="code-examples"><span class="secno">4.2.3. </span><span class="content"><code>code</code> Examples</span><a class="self-link" href="#code-examples"></a></h4>
    <div class="example" id="example-9ff74ec4">
     <a class="self-link" href="#example-9ff74ec4"></a>
			Handling the Left and Right Alt Keys


     <table class="event-sequence-table">
      <thead>
       <tr>
        <th>Keyboard Layout
        </th><th style="text-align:center"><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent③⑧">KeyboardEvent</a></code><br> <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key①⑥">key</a></code>
        </th><th style="text-align:center"><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent③⑨">KeyboardEvent</a></code><br> <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code①⑤">code</a></code>
        </th><th>Notes
      </th></tr></thead><tbody>
       <tr>
        <td>US
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Alt">Alt</a>"</code>
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="code">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-code/#code-AltLeft">AltLeft</a>"</code>
        </td><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left④">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_LEFT</a></code>
       </td></tr><tr>
        <td>French
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Alt">Alt</a>"</code>
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="code">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-code/#code-AltLeft">AltLeft</a>"</code>
        </td><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left⑤">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_LEFT</a></code>
       </td></tr><tr>
        <td>US
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Alt">Alt</a>"</code>
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="code">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-code/#code-AltRight">AltRight</a>"</code>
        </td><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right④">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_RIGHT</a></code>
       </td></tr><tr>
        <td>French
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-AltGraph">AltGraph</a>"</code>
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="code">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-code/#code-AltRight">AltRight</a>"</code>
        </td><td><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right⑤">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_RIGHT</a></code>
     </td></tr></tbody></table>
     <p>In this example, checking the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key①⑦">key</a></code> attribute permits
			matching <code class="keycap">Alt</code> without worrying about which Alt key (left or
			right) was pressed. Checking the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code①⑥">code</a></code> attribute
			permits matching the right Alt key (<code class="code">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-code/#code-AltRight">AltRight</a>"</code>) without worrying
			about which layout is currently in effect.</p>
     <p>Note that, in the French example, the <code class="keycap">Alt</code> and <code class="keycap">AltGraph</code> keys
			retain their left and right location, even though there is only one of
			each key.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="example" id="example-1af66aa2">

			Handling the Single Quote Key

        </th><th style="text-align:center"><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent④⓪">KeyboardEvent</a></code><br> <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key①⑧">key</a></code>
        </th><th style="text-align:center"><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent④①">KeyboardEvent</a></code><br> <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code①⑦">code</a></code>
        </th><th>Notes
      </th></tr></thead><tbody>
       <tr>
        <td>US
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="key">"'"</code>
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="code">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-code/#code-Quote">Quote</a>"</code>
        </td><td>
       </td></tr><tr>
        <td>Japanese
        </td><td style="text-align:center"><code class="key">":"</code>

     <p>This example shows how dead key values are encoded in the

			current locale, whereas the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code①⑧">code</a></code> attribute returns
			a consistent value.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="example" id="example-key-2">

			Handling the <code class="glyph">"2"</code> Key (with and without Shift pressed) on
			various keyboard layouts.


     <table class="event-sequence-table">
      <thead>
       <tr>
        <th>Keyboard Layout
        </th><th style="text-align:center"><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent④②">KeyboardEvent</a></code><br> <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key②⓪">key</a></code>

     <p>In the second sequence, the Shift is released before the 2,

			attribute does not match between the keydown and keyup events for
			the <code class="glyph">"2"</code> key. The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code②③">code</a></code> attribute provides a
			consistent value that is not affected by the current modifier state.</p>
