    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="4.2.4" id="code-virtual-keyboards"><span class="secno">4.2.4. </span><span class="content"><code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code②④">code</a></code> and Virtual Keyboards</span><a class="self-link" href="#code-virtual-keyboards"></a></h4>
    <p>The usefulness of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code②⑤">code</a></code> attribute is less obvious
		for virtual keyboards (and also for remote controls and chording
		keyboards). In general, if a virtual (or remote control) keyboard is
		mimicking the layout and functionality of a standard keyboard, then it
		MUST also set the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code②⑥">code</a></code> attribute as appropriate. For
		keyboards which are not mimicking the layout of a standard keyboard,
		then the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code②⑦">code</a></code> attribute MAY be set to the closest
		match on a standard keyboard or it MAY be left undefined.</p>
    <p>For virtual keyboards with keys that produce different values based on
		some modifier state, the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code②⑧">code</a></code> value should be the
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key②④">key</a></code> value generated when the button is pressed while
		the device is in its factory-reset state.</p>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="4.3" id="keys-keyvalues"><span class="secno">4.3. </span><span class="content">Keyboard Event <code>key</code> Values</span><a class="self-link" href="#keys-keyvalues"></a></h3>
    <p>A key value is a <code>DOMString</code> that can be used to indicate any
	given key on a keyboard, regardless of position or state, by the value it
	produces.  These key values MAY be used as return values for keyboard events
	generated by the implementation, or as input values by the content author to
	specify desired input (such as for keyboard shortcuts).</p>
    <p>The list of valid <code>key</code> values is defined in <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-uievents-key" title="UI Events KeyboardEvent key Values">[UIEvents-Key]</a>.</p>
    <p>Key values can be used to detect the value of a key which has been pressed,
	using the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key②⑤">key</a></code> attribute.  Content authors can retrieve the
	<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#character-value" id="ref-for-character-value⑤">character value</a> of upper- or lower-case letters, number, symbols, or
	other character-producing keys, and also the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#key-value" id="ref-for-key-value">key value</a> of control
	keys, modifier keys, function keys, or other keys that do not generate
	characters. These values can be used for monitoring particular input
	strings, for detecting and acting on modifier key input in combination with
	other inputs (such as a mouse), for creating virtual keyboards, or for any
	number of other purposes.</p>
    <p>Key values can also be used by content authors in string comparisons, as
	values for markup attributes (such as the HTML <code>accesskey</code>) in
	conforming <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#host-language" id="ref-for-host-language⑧">host languages</a>, or for other related purposes.   A
	conforming <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#host-language" id="ref-for-host-language⑨">host language</a> SHOULD allow content authors to use either
	of the two equivalent string values for a key value: the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#character-value" id="ref-for-character-value⑥">character
	value</a>, or the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#key-value" id="ref-for-key-value①">key value</a>.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
	While implementations will use the most relevant value for a key
	independently of the platform or keyboard layout mappings, content authors
	can not make assumptions on the ability of keyboard devices to generate
	them.  When using keyboard events and key values for shortcut-key
	combinations, content authors can <q>consider using numbers and function
	keys (<code class="keycap">F4</code>, <code class="keycap">F5</code>, and so on) instead of letters</q> (<a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-dww95" title="Developing International Software for Windows 95 and Windows NT: A Handbook for International Software Design">[DWW95]</a>)
	given that most keyboard layouts will provide keys for those.
	</p>
    <p>A key value does not indicate a specific key on the physical keyboard, nor
	does it reflect the character printed on the key. A key value indicates the
	current value of the event with consideration to the current state of all
	active keys and key input modes (including shift modes), as reflected in the
	operating-system mapping of the keyboard and reported to the implementation.
	In other words, the key value for the key labeled <code class="keycap">O</code> on a
	<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#qwerty" id="ref-for-qwerty">QWERTY</a> keyboard has the key value <code class="key">"o"</code> in an unshifted state and
	<code class="key">"O"</code> in a shifted state. Because a user can map their keyboard to an
	arbitrary custom configuration, the content author is encouraged not to
	assume that a relationship exists between the shifted and unshifted states
	of a key and the majuscule form (uppercase or capital letters) and minuscule
	form (lowercase or small letters) of a character representation, but is
	encouraged instead to use the value of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key②⑥">key</a></code> attribute.
	For example, the Standard "102" Keyboard layout depicted in <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-uievents-code" title="UI Events KeyboardEvent code Values">[UIEvents-Code]</a>
	illustrates one possible set of <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#key-mapping" id="ref-for-key-mapping②">key mappings</a> on one possible keyboard
	layout. Many others exist, both standard and idiosyncratic.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
	To simplify <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#dead-key" id="ref-for-dead-key①">dead key</a> support, when the operating-system mapping of
	the keyboard is handling a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#dead-key" id="ref-for-dead-key②">dead key</a> state, the current state of the
	dead key sequence is not reported via the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key②⑦">key</a></code> attribute.
	Rather, a key value of <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Dead">Dead</a>"</code> is reported. Instead, implementations
	generate <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#composition-events" id="ref-for-composition-events②">composition events</a> which
	contain the intermediate state of the dead key sequence reported via the
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data①⓪">data</a></code> attribute. As in the previous example, the key
	value for the key marked <code class="keycap">O</code> on a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#qwerty" id="ref-for-qwerty①">QWERTY</a> keyboard has a
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data①①">data</a></code> value of <code class="char">"ö"</code> in an
	unshifted state during a dead-key operation to add an umlaut diacritic, and
	<code class="char">"Ö"</code> in a shifted state during a dead-key
	operation to add an umlaut diacritic.
	</p>
    <p>It is also important to note that there is not a one-to-one relationship
	between key event states and key values.  A particular key value might be
	associated with multiple keys. For example, many standard keyboards contain
	more than one key with the <code class="keycap">Shift</code> key value (normally distinguished
	by the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location①④">location</a></code> values
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_left①⓪">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_LEFT</a></code> and
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_right⑥">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_RIGHT</a></code>) or <code class="keycap">8</code> key value (normally
	distinguished by the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location①⑤">location</a></code> values
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_standard⑧">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_STANDARD</a></code> and
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-dom_key_location_numpad⑤">DOM_KEY_LOCATION_NUMPAD</a></code>), and user-configured custom
	keyboard layouts MAY duplicate any key value in multiple key-state scenarios
	(note that <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location①⑥">location</a></code> is intended for standard keyboard
	layouts, and cannot always indicate a meaningful distinction).</p>
    <p>Finally, the meaning of any given character representation is
	context-dependent and complex.  For example, in some contexts, the asterisk
	(star) glyph (<code class="glyph">"*"</code>) represents a footnote or
	emphasis (when bracketing a passage of text). However, in some documents or
	executable programs it is equivalent to the mathematical multiplication
	operation, while in other documents or executable programs, that function is
	reserved for the multiplication symbol (<code class="glyph">"×"</code>, Unicode value
	<code class="unicode">U+00D7</code>) or the Latin small letter <code>"x"</code>
	(due to the lack of a multiplication key on many keyboards and the
	superficial resemblance of the glyphs <code class="glyph">"×"</code> and <code class="glyph">"x"</code>).  Thus,
	the semantic meaning or function of character representations is outside the
	scope of this specification.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="4.3.1" id="keys-modifiers"><span class="secno">4.3.1. </span><span class="content">Modifier keys</span><a class="self-link" href="#keys-modifiers"></a></h4>
    <p>Keyboard input uses modifier keys to change the normal behavior of a
		key. Like other keys, modifier keys generate <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown②②"><code>keydown</code></a> and
		<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup①⑧"><code>keyup</code></a> events, as shown in the example below. Some modifiers are
		activated while the key is being pressed down or maintained pressed such
		as <code class="keycap">Alt</code>, <code class="keycap">Control</code>, <code class="keycap">Shift</code>, <code class="keycap">AltGraph</code>, or
		<code class="keycap">Meta</code>. Other modifiers are activated depending on their state
		such as <code class="keycap">CapsLock</code>, <code class="keycap">NumLock</code>, or <code class="keycap">ScrollLock</code>. Change
		in the state happens when the modifier key is being pressed down. The
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent④⑧">KeyboardEvent</a></code> interface provides convenient attributes for some
		common modifiers keys: <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-ctrlkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-ctrlkey④">ctrlKey</a></code>,
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-shiftkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-shiftkey①⓪">shiftKey</a></code>, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-altkey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-altkey④">altKey</a></code>,
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-metakey" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-metakey④">metaKey</a></code>. Some operating systems simulate the
		<code class="keycap">AltGraph</code> modifier key with the combination of the <code class="keycap">Alt</code>
		and <code class="keycap">Control</code> modifier keys. Implementations are encouraged to use
		the <code class="keycap">AltGraph</code> modifier key.</p>

    <p class="note" role="note">
		The value in the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown③④"><code>keydown</code></a> and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup③①"><code>keyup</code></a> events varies based on
		the current keyboard layout in effect when the key is pressed. This
		means that the <code class="keycap">v</code> key on a US layout and the <code class="keycap">ر</code> key on an
		Arabic layout will generate different events even though they are the
		same physical key. To identify these events as coming from the same
		physical key, you will need to make use of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-code" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-code②⑨">code</a></code>
		attribute.
		</p>
    <p>In some cases, <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#modifier-key" id="ref-for-modifier-key②">modifier keys</a> change the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key③③">key</a></code>
		value for a key event. For example, on some MacOS keyboards, the  key
		labeled "delete" functions the same as the <code class="keycap">Backspace</code> key on the
		Windows OS when unmodified, but when modified by the <code class="keycap">Fn</code> key,
		acts as the <code class="keycap">Delete</code> key, and the value of <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key③④">key</a></code>
		will match the most appropriate function of the key in its current
		modified state.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="4.3.2" id="keys-dead"><span class="secno">4.3.2. </span><span class="content">Dead keys</span><a class="self-link" href="#keys-dead"></a></h4>
    <p>Some keyboard input uses <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#dead-key" id="ref-for-dead-key③">dead keys</a> for the input of composed
		character sequences. Unlike the handwriting sequence, in which users
		enter the base character first, keyboard input requires to enter a
		special state when a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#dead-key" id="ref-for-dead-key④">dead key</a> is pressed and emit the
		character(s) only when one of a limited number of <q>legal</q> base
		character is entered.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		The MacOS and Linux operating systems use input methods to process
		<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#dead-key" id="ref-for-dead-key⑤">dead keys</a>.
		</p>
    <p>The <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#dead-key" id="ref-for-dead-key⑥">dead keys</a> (across all keyboard layouts and mappings) are
		represented by the key value <code class="keycap">Dead</code>. In response to any dead key
		press, <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#composition-events" id="ref-for-composition-events③">composition events</a> must
		be dispatched by the user agent and the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionupdate" id="ref-for-compositionupdate①①"><code>compositionupdate</code></a> event’s
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data①②">data</a></code> value must be the character value of the
		current state of the dead key combining sequence.</p>
    <p>While Unicode combining characters always follow the handwriting
		sequence, with the combining character trailing the corresponding
		letter, typical dead key input MAY reverse the sequence, with the
		combining character before the corresponding letter. For example, the
		word <em>naïve</em>, using the combining diacritic <em>¨</em>, would be
		represented sequentially in Unicode as <em>nai¨ve</em>, but MAY be typed
		<em>na¨ive</em>. The sequence of keystrokes <code class="unicode">U+0302</code> (Combining

    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="4.3.3" id="keys-IME"><span class="secno">4.3.3. </span><span class="content">Input Method Editors</span><a class="self-link" href="#keys-IME"></a></h4>
    <p>This specification includes a model for <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input-method-editor" id="ref-for-input-method-editor②">input method editors</a>
		(IMEs), through the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent①⑤">CompositionEvent</a></code> interface and events.
		However, Composition Events and Keyboard Events do not necessarily map
		as a one-to-one relationship.  As an example, receiving a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown④⓪"><code>keydown</code></a>
		for the <code class="keycap">Accept</code> key value does not necessarily imply that the
		text currently selected in the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime④">IME</a> is being accepted, but
		indicates only that a keystroke happened, disconnected from the
		<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime⑤">IME</a> Accept functionality (which would normally result in a
		<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#compositionend" id="ref-for-compositionend①⑤"><code>compositionend</code></a> event in most <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime⑥">IME</a> systems).  Keyboard
		events cannot be used to determine the current state of the input method
		editor, which can be obtained through the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-compositionevent-data" id="ref-for-dom-compositionevent-data①⑤">data</a></code>
		attribute of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#compositionevent" id="ref-for-compositionevent①⑥">CompositionEvent</a></code> interface.  Additionally,
		<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime⑦">IME</a> systems and devices vary in their functionality, and in which
		keys are used for activating that functionality, such that the
		<code class="keycap">Convert</code> and <code class="keycap">Accept</code> keys MAY be represented by other
		available keys. Keyboard events correspond to the events generated by
		the input device after the keyboard layout mapping.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		In some implementations or system configurations, some key events, or
		their values, might be suppressed by the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime⑧">IME</a> in use.
		</p>
    <p>The following example describes a possible sequence of keys to generate
		the Unicode character <code class="glyph">"市"</code> (Kanji character, part of CJK
		Unified Ideographs) using Japanese input methods. This example assumes
		that the input method editor is activated and in the Japanese-Romaji
		input mode. The keys <code class="keycap">Convert</code> and <code class="keycap">Accept</code> MAY be replaced
		by others depending on the input device in use and the configuration of
		the IME, e.g., it can be respectively <code class="unicode">U+0020</code> (Space key) and
		<code class="keycap">Enter</code>.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		<code class="glyph">"詩"</code> (<q>poem</q>) and <code class="glyph">"市"</code> (<q>city</q>) are
		homophones, both pronounced し (<q>shi</q>/<q>si</q>), so the user
		needs to use the <code class="keycap">Convert</code> key to select the proper option.
		</p>

    <p class="note" role="note">
		Some <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input-method-editor" id="ref-for-input-method-editor③">input method editors</a> (such as on the MacOS operating system)
		might set an <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#empty-string" id="ref-for-empty-string⑨">empty string</a> to the composition data attribute
		before canceling a composition.
		</p>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="4.3.3.1" id="keys-IME-keys"><span class="secno">4.3.3.1. </span><span class="content">Input Method Editor mode keys</span><a class="self-link" href="#keys-IME-keys"></a></h5>
    <p>Some keys on certain devices are intended to activate <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input-method-editor" id="ref-for-input-method-editor④">input
			method editor</a> functionality, or to change the mode of an active
			<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input-method-editor" id="ref-for-input-method-editor⑤">input method editor</a>.  Custom keys for this purpose can be
			defined for different devices or language modes. The keys defined in
			this specification for this purpose are: <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Alphanumeric">Alphanumeric</a>"</code>,
			<code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-CodeInput">CodeInput</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-FinalMode">FinalMode</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-HangulMode">HangulMode</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-HanjaMode">HanjaMode</a>"</code>,
			<code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Hiragana">Hiragana</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-JunjaMode">JunjaMode</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-KanaMode">KanaMode</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-KanjiMode">KanjiMode</a>"</code>,
			<code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Katakana">Katakana</a>"</code>, and <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Romaji">Romaji</a>"</code>.  When one of these keys is
			pressed, and no <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime⑨">IME</a> is currently active, the appropriate
			<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime①⓪">IME</a> is expected to be activated in the mode indicated by the
			key (if available). If an <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime①①">IME</a> is already active when the key
			is pressed, the active <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime①②">IME</a> might change to the indicated
			mode, or a different <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#ime" id="ref-for-ime①③">IME</a> might be launched, or the might MAY
			be ignored, on a device- and application-specific basis.</p>
    <p>This specification also defines other keys which are intended for
			operation specifically with <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input-method-editor" id="ref-for-input-method-editor⑥">input method editors</a>:
			<code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Accept">Accept</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-AllCandidates">AllCandidates</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Cancel">Cancel</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Convert">Convert</a>"</code>,
			<code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Compose">Compose</a>"</code>, <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Zenkaku">Zenkaku</a>"</code> (FullWidth), <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-Hankaku">Hankaku</a>"</code> (HalfWidth), <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-NextCandidate">NextCandidate</a>"</code>,
			<code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-NonConvert">NonConvert</a>"</code>, and <code class="key">"<a href="http://www.w3.org/TR/uievents-key/#key-PreviousCandidate">PreviousCandidate</a>"</code>.  The functions of these
			keys are not defined in this specification — refer to other
			resources for details on <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input-method-editor" id="ref-for-input-method-editor⑦">input method editor</a> functionality.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
			Keys with <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input-method-editor" id="ref-for-input-method-editor⑧">input method editor</a> functions are not restricted to
			that purpose, and can have other device- or implementation-specific
			purposes.
			</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="4.3.4" id="keys-cancelable-keys"><span class="secno">4.3.4. </span><span class="content">Default actions and cancelable keyboard events</span><a class="self-link" href="#keys-cancelable-keys"></a></h4>
    <p>Canceling the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#default-action" id="ref-for-default-action⑤">default action</a> of a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown⑤①"><code>keydown</code></a> event MUST NOT

		respective <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#beforeinput" id="ref-for-beforeinput②⑤"><code>beforeinput</code></a> and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#input" id="ref-for-input②⑥"><code>input</code></a> (and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keypress" id="ref-for-keypress④"><code>keypress</code></a> if

    <p>If the key is part of a sequence of several keystrokes, whether it is a
		<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#dead-key" id="ref-for-dead-key⑧">dead key</a> or it is contributing to an Input Method Editor

		Canceling a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#dead-key" id="ref-for-dead-key⑨">dead key</a> on a <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup⑤①"><code>keyup</code></a> event has no effect on

   <section>
    <h2 class="heading settled" data-level="5" id="external-algorithms"><span class="secno">5. </span><span class="content">External Algorithms</span><a class="self-link" href="#external-algorithms"></a></h2>
    <p>This sections contains algorithms that are required by this specification, but are
	more properly hosted by other specifications.</p>
    <p>The intent is that this sections serve as a temporary home for these definitions,
	and they should eventually be moved into a more appropriate home so this entire
	section can be deleted.</p>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="5.1" id="external-dom-algorithms"><span class="secno">5.1. </span><span class="content">Core DOM Algorithms</span><a class="self-link" href="#external-dom-algorithms"></a></h3>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		The following algorithms should be moved... somewhere.
		</p>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="5.2" id="external-pointerlock-algorithms"><span class="secno">5.2. </span><span class="content">PointerLock Algorithms</span><a class="self-link" href="#external-pointerlock-algorithms"></a></h3>
    <p class="note" role="note">
		The following algorithm should be moved into the <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-pointerlock" title="Pointer Lock 2.0">[PointerLock]</a> spec.
		</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="5.2.1" id="pointer-lock-global-state"><span class="secno">5.2.1. </span><span class="content">Global State for PointerLock</span><a class="self-link" href="#pointer-lock-global-state"></a></h4>
    <h5 class="heading settled" data-level="5.2.1.1" id="pointer-lock-global-window"><span class="secno">5.2.1.1. </span><span class="content">Window-Level State</span><a class="self-link" href="#pointer-lock-global-window"></a></h5>
    <p>The UA must maintain the following values that are shared for the Window.</p>
    <p>A <dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="last-mouse-move" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">last mouse move</dfn> value (initially undefined) that records the position of the
				last mousemove event.</p>
    <div class="algorithm" data-algorithm="initialize-pointerlock-attributes-for-mouseevent">
     <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="5.2.2" id="initialize-pointerlock-attributes-for-mouseevent-id"><span class="secno">5.2.2. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-export="" id="initialize-pointerlock-attributes-for-mouseevent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">initialize PointerLock attributes for MouseEvent</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#initialize-pointerlock-attributes-for-mouseevent-id"></a></h4>
     <dl>
      <dt data-md="">Input
      </dt><dd data-md="">
       <p><var>event</var>, a <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent⑦">MouseEvent</a></code></p>
      </dd><dt data-md="">Output
      </dt><dd data-md="">
       <p>None</p>
     </dd></dl>
     <ol>
      <li data-md="">
       <p>Set <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerlock/#dom-mouseevent-movementx" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-movementx">movementX</a></code> = 0</p>
      </li><li data-md="">
       <p>Set <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerlock/#dom-mouseevent-movementy" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-movementy">movementY</a></code> = 0</p>
     </li></ol>
    </div>
    <div class="algorithm" data-algorithm="set-pointerlock-attributes-for-mousemove">
     <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="5.2.3" id="set-pointerlock-attributes-for-mousemove-id"><span class="secno">5.2.3. </span><span class="content"><dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-export="" id="set-pointerlock-attributes-for-mousemove" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">set PointerLock attributes for mousemove</dfn></span><a class="self-link" href="#set-pointerlock-attributes-for-mousemove-id"></a></h4>
     <dl>
      <dt data-md="">Input
      </dt><dd data-md="">
       <p><var>event</var>, a <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent⑧">MouseEvent</a></code></p>
      </dd><dt data-md="">Output
      </dt><dd data-md="">
       <p>None</p>
     </dd></dl>
     <ol>
      <li data-md="">
       <p>If <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-type" id="ref-for-dom-event-type②">type</a></code> is not "mousemove", then exit</p>
      </li><li data-md="">
       <p>If <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#last-mouse-move" id="ref-for-last-mouse-move">last mouse move</a> is not defined, then</p>
       <ol>
        <li data-md="">
         <p>Set <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerlock/#dom-mouseevent-movementx" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-movementx①">movementX</a></code> = 0</p>
        </li><li data-md="">
         <p>Set <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerlock/#dom-mouseevent-movementy" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-movementy①">movementY</a></code> = 0</p>
       </li></ol>
      </li><li data-md="">
       <p>Otherwise,</p>
       <ol>
        <li data-md="">
         <p>Set <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerlock/#dom-mouseevent-movementx" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-movementx②">movementX</a></code> = <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent-screenx" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-screenx">screenX</a></code> - <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#last-mouse-move" id="ref-for-last-mouse-move①">last mouse move</a>’s x-coordinate</p>
        </li><li data-md="">
         <p>Set <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerlock/#dom-mouseevent-movementy" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-movementy②">movementY</a></code> = <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent-screenx" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-screenx①">screenX</a></code> - <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#last-mouse-move" id="ref-for-last-mouse-move②">last mouse move</a>’s y-coordinate</p>
       </li></ol>
      </li><li data-md="">
       <p>Set <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#last-mouse-move" id="ref-for-last-mouse-move③">last mouse move</a> = ( <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent-screenx" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-screenx②">screenX</a></code>, <var>event</var>.<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent-screeny" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-screeny">screenY</a></code> )</p>
     </li></ol>
    </div>
   </section>
   <section>
    <h2 class="heading settled" data-level="6" id="legacy-event-initializers"><span class="secno">6. </span><span class="content">Legacy Event Initializers</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-event-initializers"></a></h2>
    <p><em>This section is normative.
The following features are obsolete and should only be implemented by
<a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent②⑤">user agents</a> that require compatibility with legacy software.</em></p>
    <p>Early versions of this specification included an initialization method on
the interface (for example <code>initMouseEvent</code>) that required a long
list of parameters that, in most cases, did not fully initialize all
attributes of the event object. Because of this, event interfaces which were
derived from the basic <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event" id="ref-for-event③①">Event</a></code> interface required that the initializer of
<em>each</em> of the derived interfaces be called explicitly in order to
fully initialize an event.</p>
    <div class="example" id="example-7a1fe96e"><a class="self-link" href="#example-7a1fe96e"></a>
Initializing all the attributes of a UIEvent requires calls to two
initializer methods: <code>initEvent</code> and
<code>initUIEvent</code>.
</div>
    <p>Due in part to the length of time in the development of this standard, some
implementations MAY have taken a dependency on these (now deprecated)
initializer methods. For completeness, these legacy event initializers are
described in this Appendix.</p>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="6.1" id="legacy-event-initializer-interfaces"><span class="secno">6.1. </span><span class="content">Legacy Event Initializer Interfaces</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-event-initializer-interfaces"></a></h3>
    <p><em>This section is informative</em></p>
    <p>This section documents legacy initializer methods that were introduced
	in earlier versions of this specification.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="6.1.1" id="idl-interface-UIEvent-initializers"><span class="secno">6.1.1. </span><span class="content">Initializers for interface UIEvent</span><a class="self-link" href="#idl-interface-UIEvent-initializers"></a></h4>
<pre class="def highlight idl"><c- b="">partial</c-> <c- b="">interface</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④⑥"><c- g="">UIEvent</c-></a> {
  // Deprecated in this specification
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined"><c- b="">undefined</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="method" href="#dom-uievent-inituievent" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-inituievent"><c- g="">initUIEvent</c-></a>(<a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString②②"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, detailArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-uievent-inituievent-typearg-bubblesarg-cancelablearg-viewarg-detailarg-typearg" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">typeArg</c-></code></dfn>,
    <c- b="">optional</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean④⑨"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, detailArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-uievent-inituievent-typearg-bubblesarg-cancelablearg-viewarg-detailarg-bubblesarg" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">bubblesArg</c-></code></dfn> = <c- b="">false</c->,
    <c- b="">optional</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean⑤⓪"><c- b="">boolean</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, detailArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-uievent-inituievent-typearg-bubblesarg-cancelablearg-viewarg-detailarg-cancelablearg" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">cancelableArg</c-></code></dfn> = <c- b="">false</c->,
    <c- b="">optional</c-> <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#window" id="ref-for-window③⑦"><c- n="">Window</c-></a>? <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, detailArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-uievent-inituievent-typearg-bubblesarg-cancelablearg-viewarg-detailarg-viewarg" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">viewArg</c-></code></dfn> = <c- b="">null</c->,
    <c- b="">optional</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long" id="ref-for-idl-long②"><c- b="">long</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, detailArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg), UIEvent/initUIEvent(typeArg)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-uievent-inituievent-typearg-bubblesarg-cancelablearg-viewarg-detailarg-detailarg" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">detailArg</c-></code></dfn> = 0);
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent" data-dfn-type="method" data-export="" data-lt="initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, detailArg)|initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg)|initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg)|initUIEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg)|initUIEvent(typeArg)" id="dom-uievent-inituievent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>initUIEvent(typeArg)</code></dfn>
     </dt><dd>
      
				Initializes attributes of an <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④⑦">UIEvent</a></code> object.
				This method has the same behavior as <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent" id="ref-for-dom-event-initevent①">initEvent()</a></code>.

				
      <p class="warning">
				The <code>initUIEvent</code> method is deprecated, but
				supported for backwards-compatibility with widely-deployed
				implementations.
				</p>
      <dl class="parameters">
       <dt>DOMString typeArg
       </dt><dd>
						Refer to the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent" id="ref-for-dom-event-initevent②">initEvent()</a></code> method for a description of this parameter.
					
       </dd><dt>boolean bubblesArg
       </dt><dd>
						Refer to the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent" id="ref-for-dom-event-initevent③">initEvent()</a></code> method for a description of this parameter.
					
       </dd><dt>boolean cancelableArg
       </dt><dd>
						Refer to the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent" id="ref-for-dom-event-initevent④">initEvent()</a></code> method for a description of this parameter.
					
       </dd><dt>Window? viewArg
       </dt><dd>
						Specifies <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view①⑦">view</a></code>. This value MAY be <code>null</code>.
					
       </dd><dt>long detailArg
       </dt><dd>
						Specifies <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail①⑦">detail</a></code>.

     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="method" data-export="" data-lt="initKeyboardEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, keyArg, locationArg, ctrlKey, altKey, shiftKey, metaKey)|initKeyboardEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, keyArg, locationArg, ctrlKey, altKey, shiftKey)|initKeyboardEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, keyArg, locationArg, ctrlKey, altKey)|initKeyboardEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, keyArg, locationArg, ctrlKey)|initKeyboardEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, keyArg, locationArg)|initKeyboardEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, keyArg)|initKeyboardEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg)|initKeyboardEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg)|initKeyboardEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg)|initKeyboardEvent(typeArg)" id="dom-keyboardevent-initkeyboardevent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>initKeyboardEvent(typeArg)</code></dfn>
     </dt><dd>
      
				Initializes attributes of a <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑥⑥">KeyboardEvent</a></code> object. This
				method has the same behavior as <code>UIEvent.initUIEvent()</code>.
				The value of <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail①⑧">detail</a></code> remains undefined.

				
      <p class="warning">
				The <code>initKeyboardEvent</code> method is deprecated.
				</p>
      <dl class="parameters">
       <dt>DOMString typeArg
       </dt><dd>
						Refer to the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent" id="ref-for-dom-event-initevent⑤">initEvent()</a></code> method for a description of this parameter.
					
       </dd><dt>boolean bubblesArg
       </dt><dd>
						Refer to the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent" id="ref-for-dom-event-initevent⑥">initEvent()</a></code> method for a description of this parameter.
					
       </dd><dt>boolean cancelableArg
       </dt><dd>
						Refer to the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent" id="ref-for-dom-event-initevent⑦">initEvent()</a></code> method for a description of this parameter.
					
       </dd><dt>Window? viewArg
       </dt><dd>
						Specifies <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view①⑧">view</a></code>. This value MAY be <code>null</code>.
					
       </dd><dt>DOMString keyArg
       </dt><dd>
						Specifies <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key④②">key</a></code>.
					
       </dd><dt>unsigned long locationArg
       </dt><dd>
						Specifies <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-location" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-location①⑦">location</a></code>.
					
       </dd><dt>boolean ctrlKey
       </dt><dd>
						Specifies whether the Control key modifier is active.
					
       </dd><dt>boolean altKey
       </dt><dd>
						Specifies whether the Alt key modifier is active.
					
       </dd><dt>boolean shiftKey
       </dt><dd>
						Specifies whether the Shift key modifier is active.
					
       </dd><dt>boolean metaKey
       </dt><dd>
						Specifies whether the Meta key modifier is active.
					
      </dd></dl>

    <c- b="">optional</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString" id="ref-for-idl-DOMString②⑥"><c- b="">DOMString</c-></a> <dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="CompositionEvent/initCompositionEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, dataArg), CompositionEvent/initCompositionEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg), CompositionEvent/initCompositionEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg), CompositionEvent/initCompositionEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg), CompositionEvent/initCompositionEvent(typeArg)" data-dfn-type="argument" data-export="" id="dom-compositionevent-initcompositionevent-typearg-bubblesarg-cancelablearg-viewarg-dataarg-dataarg" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code><c- g="">dataArg</c-></code></dfn> = "");
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="CompositionEvent" data-dfn-type="method" data-export="" data-lt="initCompositionEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg, dataArg)|initCompositionEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg, viewArg)|initCompositionEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg, cancelableArg)|initCompositionEvent(typeArg, bubblesArg)|initCompositionEvent(typeArg)" id="dom-compositionevent-initcompositionevent" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>initCompositionEvent(typeArg)</code></dfn>
     </dt><dd>
      
				Initializes attributes of a <code>CompositionEvent</code>
				object. This method has the same behavior as
				<code>UIEvent.initUIEvent()</code>. The value of <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-detail" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-detail①⑨">detail</a></code>
				remains undefined.

				
      <p class="warning">
				The <code>initCompositionEvent</code> method is deprecated.
				</p>
      <dl class="parameters">
       <dt>DOMString typeArg
       </dt><dd>
						Refer to the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent" id="ref-for-dom-event-initevent⑧">initEvent()</a></code> method for a description of this parameter.
					
       </dd><dt>boolean bubblesArg
       </dt><dd>
						Refer to the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent" id="ref-for-dom-event-initevent⑨">initEvent()</a></code> method for a description of this parameter.
					
       </dd><dt>boolean cancelableArg
       </dt><dd>
						Refer to the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent" id="ref-for-dom-event-initevent①⓪">initEvent()</a></code> method for a description of this parameter.
					
       </dd><dt>Window? viewArg
       </dt><dd>
						Specifies <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-view" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-view①⑨">view</a></code>. This value MAY be <code>null</code>.
					
       </dd><dt>DOMString dataArg

      </dd></dl>
    </dd></dl>
   </section>
   <section>
    <h2 class="heading settled" data-level="7" id="legacy-key-attributes"><span class="secno">7. </span><span class="content">Legacy Key & Mouse Event Attributes</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-key-attributes"></a></h2>
    <p><em>This section is non-normative. The following attributes are obsolete and should
only be implemented by <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent②⑥">user agents</a> that require compatibility with legacy
software that requires these keyboard events.</em></p>
    <p>These features were never formally specified and the current browser
implementations vary in significant ways. The large amount of legacy content,
including script libraries, that relies upon detecting the <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent②⑦">user agent</a> and
acting accordingly means that any attempt to formalize these legacy attributes
and events would risk breaking as much content as it would fix or enable.
Additionally, these attributes are not suitable for international usage, nor do
they address accessibility concerns.</p>
    <p>Therefore, this specification does not normatively define the events and
attributes commonly employed for handling keyboard input, though they MAY be
present in <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent②⑧">user agents</a> for compatibility with legacy content. Authors
SHOULD use the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key④③">key</a></code> attribute instead of the
<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode">charCode</a></code> and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode">keyCode</a></code> attributes.</p>
    <p>However, for the purpose of documenting the current state of these features and
their relation to normative events and attributes, this section provides an
informative description. For implementations which do support these attributes
and events, it is suggested that the definitions provided in this section be
used.</p>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="7.1" id="legacy-UIEvent"><span class="secno">7.1. </span><span class="content">Legacy <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④⑧">UIEvent</a></code> supplemental interface</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-UIEvent"></a></h3>
    <p><em>This section is non-normative</em></p>
    <p><a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent②⑨">User agents</a> have traditionally included a <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which①">which</a></code> attribute so that
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑥⑦">KeyboardEvent</a></code>s and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent⑨">MouseEvent</a></code>s could record supplemental event info.</p>
    <p class="note" role="note">
	Previous versions of this specification defined separate <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which②">which</a></code> attributes
	directly on <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑥⑧">KeyboardEvent</a></code> and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent①⓪">MouseEvent</a></code> rather than having a shared
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which③">which</a></code> attribute defined on <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent④⑨">UIEvent</a></code>.
	</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="7.1.1" id="legacy-interface-UIEvent"><span class="secno">7.1.1. </span><span class="content">Interface UIEvent (supplemental)</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-interface-UIEvent"></a></h4>
    <p>The partial <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑤⓪">UIEvent</a></code> interface is an informative extension of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑤①">UIEvent</a></code>
		interface, which adds the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which④">which</a></code> attribute.</p>
<pre class="def highlight idl"><c- b="">partial</c-> <c- b="">interface</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑤②"><c- g="">UIEvent</c-></a> {
  // The following support legacy user agents
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long⑨"><c- b="">unsigned</c-> <c- b="">long</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="attribute" data-readonly="" data-type="unsigned long" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which⑤"><c- g="">which</c-></a>;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-uievent-which" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>which</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long①⓪">unsigned long</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
				For <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent①①">MouseEvent</a></code>s, this contains a value equal to the value stored in
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent-button" id="ref-for-dom-mouseevent-button">button</a></code>+1.
				For <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑥⑨">KeyboardEvent</a></code>s, this holds a system- and implementation-dependent
				numerical code signifying the unmodified identifier associated
				with the key pressed. In most cases, the value is identical to
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①">keyCode</a></code>.
			
    </dd></dl>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="7.1.2" id="legacy-dictionary-UIEventInit"><span class="secno">7.1.2. </span><span class="content">Interface UIEventInit (supplemental)</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-dictionary-UIEventInit"></a></h4>
    <p>Browsers that include support for <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which⑥">which</a></code> in
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑤③">UIEvent</a></code> should also add the following members to the
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-uieventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-uieventinit⑦">UIEventInit</a></code> dictionary.</p>
    <p>The partial <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-uieventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-uieventinit⑧">UIEventInit</a></code> dictionary is an informative extension
		of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-uieventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-uieventinit⑨">UIEventInit</a></code> dictionary, which adds the
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which⑦">which</a></code> member to initialize the corresponding
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑤④">UIEvent</a></code> attributes.</p>
<pre class="def highlight idl"><c- b="">partial</c-> <c- b="">dictionary</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="dictionary" href="#dictdef-uieventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-uieventinit①⓪"><c- g="">UIEventInit</c-></a> {
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long①①"><c- b="">unsigned</c-> <c- b="">long</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="0" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="unsigned long" href="#dom-uieventinit-which" id="ref-for-dom-uieventinit-which"><c- g="">which</c-></a> = 0;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="UIEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-noexport="" id="dom-uieventinit-which" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>which</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long①②">unsigned long</a>, defaulting to <code>0</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
				Initializes the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which⑧">which</a></code> attribute of the
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑤⑤">UIEvent</a></code>.
			
    </dd></dl>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="7.2" id="legacy-KeyboardEvent"><span class="secno">7.2. </span><span class="content">Legacy <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑦⓪">KeyboardEvent</a></code> supplemental interface</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-KeyboardEvent"></a></h3>
    <p><em>This section is non-normative</em></p>
    <p>Browser support for keyboards has traditionally relied on three ad-hoc
	attributes, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode②">keyCode</a></code>, <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode①">charCode</a></code>, and
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#uievent" id="ref-for-uievent⑤⑥">UIEvent</a></code>’s <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which⑨">which</a></code>.</p>
    <p>All three of these attributes return a numerical code that represents some
	aspect of the key pressed: <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode③">keyCode</a></code> is an index of the key
	itself. <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode②">charCode</a></code> is the ASCII value of the character keys.
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-uievent-which" id="ref-for-dom-uievent-which①⓪">which</a></code> is the character value where available and otherwise
	the key index. The values for these attributes, and the availability of the
	attribute, is inconsistent across platforms, keyboard languages and layouts,
	<a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent③⓪">user agents</a>, versions, and even event types.</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="7.2.1" id="legacy-interface-KeyboardEvent"><span class="secno">7.2.1. </span><span class="content">Interface KeyboardEvent (supplemental)</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-interface-KeyboardEvent"></a></h4>
    <p>The partial <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑦①">KeyboardEvent</a></code> interface is an informative extension of
		the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑦②">KeyboardEvent</a></code> interface, which adds the
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode③">charCode</a></code> and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode④">keyCode</a></code> attributes.</p>
    <p>The partial <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑦③">KeyboardEvent</a></code> interface can be obtained by using the
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-createevent" id="ref-for-dom-document-createevent①">createEvent()</a></code> method call in
		implementations that support this extension.</p>
<pre class="def highlight idl"><c- b="">partial</c-> <c- b="">interface</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑦④"><c- g="">KeyboardEvent</c-></a> {
  // The following support legacy user agents
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long①③"><c- b="">unsigned</c-> <c- b="">long</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="attribute" data-readonly="" data-type="unsigned long" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode④"><c- g="">charCode</c-></a>;
  <c- b="">readonly</c-> <c- b="">attribute</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long①④"><c- b="">unsigned</c-> <c- b="">long</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="attribute" data-readonly="" data-type="unsigned long" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode⑤"><c- g="">keyCode</c-></a>;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-charcode" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>charCode</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long①⑤">unsigned long</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode⑤">charCode</a></code> holds a character value, for
				<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keypress" id="ref-for-keypress⑥"><code>keypress</code></a> events which generate character input. The value
				is the Unicode reference number (code point) of that character
				(e.g. <code>event.charCode = event.key.charCodeAt(0)</code> for
				printable characters). For <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown⑤⑨"><code>keydown</code></a> or <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup⑤④"><code>keyup</code></a>
				events, the value of <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode⑥">charCode</a></code> is
				<code>0</code>.
			
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEvent" data-dfn-type="attribute" data-export="" id="dom-keyboardevent-keycode" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>keyCode</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long①⑥">unsigned long</a>, readonly</span>
     </dt><dd>
      
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode⑥">keyCode</a></code> holds a system- and
				implementation-dependent numerical code signifying the
				unmodified identifier associated with the key pressed. Unlike
				the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-key" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-key④④">key</a></code> attribute, the set of possible values
				are not normatively defined in this specification. Typically,
				these value of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode⑦">keyCode</a></code> SHOULD represent
				the decimal codepoint in ASCII <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-rfc20" title="ASCII format for network interchange">[RFC20]</a><a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-us-ascii" title="Coded Character Set - 7-Bit American Standard Code for Information Interchange">[US-ASCII]</a> or Windows
				1252 <a data-link-type="biblio" href="#biblio-win1252" title="Windows 1252 a Coded Character Set - 8-Bit">[WIN1252]</a>, but MAY be drawn from a different appropriate
				character set. Implementations that are unable to identify a key
				use the key value <code class="keycap">0</code>.


      <p>See <a href="#legacy-key-models">§ 7.3 Legacy key models</a> for more details on how to determine
				the values for <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode⑧">keyCode</a></code>.</p>
    </dd></dl>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="7.2.2" id="legacy-dictionary-KeyboardEventInit"><span class="secno">7.2.2. </span><span class="content">Interface KeyboardEventInit (supplemental)</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-dictionary-KeyboardEventInit"></a></h4>
    <p>Browsers that include support for <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode⑨">keyCode</a></code>
		and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode⑦">charCode</a></code> in
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑦⑤">KeyboardEvent</a></code> should also add the following members to the
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-keyboardeventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-keyboardeventinit②">KeyboardEventInit</a></code> dictionary.</p>
    <p>The partial <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-keyboardeventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-keyboardeventinit③">KeyboardEventInit</a></code> dictionary is an informative extension
		of the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dictdef-keyboardeventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-keyboardeventinit④">KeyboardEventInit</a></code> dictionary, which adds
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode⑧">charCode</a></code> and <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①⓪">keyCode</a></code>
		members to initialize the corresponding
		<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑦⑥">KeyboardEvent</a></code> attributes.</p>
<pre class="def highlight idl"><c- b="">partial</c-> <c- b="">dictionary</c-> <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="dictionary" href="#dictdef-keyboardeventinit" id="ref-for-dictdef-keyboardeventinit⑤"><c- g="">KeyboardEventInit</c-></a> {
  // The following support legacy user agents
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long①⑦"><c- b="">unsigned</c-> <c- b="">long</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="0" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="unsigned long" href="#dom-keyboardeventinit-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardeventinit-charcode"><c- g="">charCode</c-></a> = 0;
  <a class="idl-code" data-link-type="interface" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long①⑧"><c- b="">unsigned</c-> <c- b="">long</c-></a> <a class="idl-code" data-default="0" data-link-type="dict-member" data-type="unsigned long" href="#dom-keyboardeventinit-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardeventinit-keycode"><c- g="">keyCode</c-></a> = 0;
};
</pre>
    <dl>
     <dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-noexport="" id="dom-keyboardeventinit-charcode" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>charCode</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long①⑨">unsigned long</a>, defaulting to <code>0</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
				Initializes the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode⑨">charCode</a></code> attribute of the
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑦⑦">KeyboardEvent</a></code> to the Unicode code point for the event’s
				character.
			
     </dd><dt><dfn class="dfn-paneled idl-code has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-for="KeyboardEventInit" data-dfn-type="dict-member" data-noexport="" id="dom-keyboardeventinit-keycode" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><code>keyCode</code></dfn>, <span> of type <a data-link-type="idl-name" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long" id="ref-for-idl-unsigned-long②⓪">unsigned long</a>, defaulting to <code>0</code></span>
     </dt><dd>
				Initializes the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①①">keyCode</a></code> attribute of the
				<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#keyboardevent" id="ref-for-keyboardevent⑦⑧">KeyboardEvent</a></code> to the system- and implementation-dependent
				numerical code signifying the unmodified identifier associated
				with the key pressed.
			
    </dd></dl>
    <h3 class="heading settled" data-level="7.3" id="legacy-key-models"><span class="secno">7.3. </span><span class="content">Legacy key models</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-key-models"></a></h3>
    <p><em>This section is non-normative</em></p>
    <p>Implementations differ on which values are exposed on these attributes for
	different event types. An implementation MAY choose to expose both virtual
	key codes and character codes in the <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①②">keyCode</a></code> property
	(<em>conflated model</em>), or report separate <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①③">keyCode</a></code> and
	<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-charcode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-charcode①⓪">charCode</a></code> properties (<em>split model</em>).</p>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="7.3.1" id="determine-keydown-keyup-keyCode"><span class="secno">7.3.1. </span><span class="content">How to determine <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①④">keyCode</a></code> for <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown⑥⓪"><code>keydown</code></a> and <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup⑤⑤"><code>keyup</code></a> events</span><a class="self-link" href="#determine-keydown-keyup-keyCode"></a></h4>
    <p>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①⑤">keyCode</a></code> for <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown⑥①"><code>keydown</code></a> or <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keyup" id="ref-for-keyup⑤⑥"><code>keyup</code></a> events
		is calculated as follows:</p>
    <ul>
     <li data-md="">
      <p>Read the virtual key code from the operating system’s event
information, if such information is available.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>If an Input Method Editor is processing key input and the event is
<a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keydown" id="ref-for-keydown⑥②"><code>keydown</code></a>, return 229.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>If input key when pressed without modifiers would insert a numerical
character (0-9), return the ASCII code of that numerical character.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>If input key when pressed without modifiers would insert a lower
case character in the a-z alphabetical range, return the ASCII code
of the upper case equivalent.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>If the implementation supports a key code conversion table for the
operating system and platform, look up the value. If the conversion
table specifies an alternate virtual key value for the given input,
return the specified value.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>If the key’s function, as determined in an implementation-specific
way, corresponds to one of the keys in the
<a href="#fixed-virtual-key-codes">§ 7.3.3 Fixed virtual key codes</a> table, return the corresponding key
code.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>Return the virtual key code from the operating system.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>If no key code was found, return 0.</p>
    </li></ul>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="7.3.2" id="determine-keypress-keyCode"><span class="secno">7.3.2. </span><span class="content">How to determine <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①⑥">keyCode</a></code> for <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keypress" id="ref-for-keypress⑦"><code>keypress</code></a> events</span><a class="self-link" href="#determine-keypress-keyCode"></a></h4>
    <p>The <code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①⑦">keyCode</a></code> for <a data-link-type="dfn" href="#keypress" id="ref-for-keypress⑧"><code>keypress</code></a> events is calculated
		as follows:</p>
    <ul>
     <li data-md="">
      <p>If the implementation supports a <em>conflated model</em>, set
<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①⑧">keyCode</a></code> to the Unicode code point of the character
being entered.</p>
     </li><li data-md="">
      <p>If the implementation supports a <em>split model</em>, set
<code class="idl"><a data-link-type="idl" href="#dom-keyboardevent-keycode" id="ref-for-dom-keyboardevent-keycode①⑨">keyCode</a></code> to 0.</p>
    </li></ul>
    <h4 class="heading settled" data-level="7.3.3" id="fixed-virtual-key-codes"><span class="secno">7.3.3. </span><span class="content">Fixed virtual key codes</span><a class="self-link" href="#fixed-virtual-key-codes"></a></h4>

   <section>
    <h2 class="heading settled" data-level="8" id="legacy-event-types"><span class="secno">8. </span><span class="content">Legacy Event Types</span><a class="self-link" href="#legacy-event-types"></a></h2>
    <p><em>This section is normative. The following event types are obsolete and should
only be implemented by <a data-link-type="dfn" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#user-agent" id="ref-for-user-agent③①">user agents</a> that require compatibility with legacy
software.</em></p>
    <p>The purpose of this section is to document the current state of these features
and their relation to normative events. For implementations which do support
these events, it is suggested that the definitions provided in this section be
used.</p>
    <p>The following table provides an informative summary of the event types which are
deprecated in this specification. They are included here for reference and
completeness.</p>
